title.zh-TW: Claude 應用程式閘道支援 Bedrock 角色切換與安全護欄
title.en: Claude apps gateway adds Bedrock role assumption and guardrails

body.zh-TW: 企業在雲端集中控管模型流量時，閘道在上游設定中新增了 `assume_role` 欄位。這讓閘道能透過 STS 取得臨時憑證呼叫 Amazon Bedrock，甚至跨到其他 AWS 帳號，並支援為每位開發者提供獨立的工作階段。同時上游也支援配置 `guardrail: {id, version}`，強制所有請求通過指定的安全護欄檢查。⟦如同總部派出專車前往各分部載貨時，能換上該廠區的專屬通行證，且出發前一律通過安檢門過濾違規物品。⟧
body.en: When enterprises centrally manage model traffic in the cloud, the gateway adds an `assume_role` field in upstream settings. This allows the gateway to call Amazon Bedrock using temporary credentials assumed through STS, across other AWS accounts if needed, while supporting one session per developer. Upstreams also support configuring `guardrail: {id, version}` to require all requests to pass through a specified safety guardrail. ⟦Picture headquarters dispatching dedicated trucks to branch facilities where they put on site-specific passes, while every vehicle passes through a security gate to filter out prohibited items before departure.⟧

items.original:
Added `assume_role` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams: the gateway calls Bedrock as an IAM role it assumes through STS, in another AWS account if needed, optionally one session per developer
Added `guardrail: {id, version}` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams to apply an Amazon Bedrock guardrail to every request sent through them (set it on all Bedrock upstreams or none)

title.zh-TW: Claude 應用程式閘道擴充桌面端原則與固定遙測標籤
title.en: Claude apps gateway expands Desktop policies and fixed telemetry labels

body.zh-TW: 公司統一配置開發環境時，閘道的桌面端原則區塊新增了多項控管鍵。管理者能設定禁止讀取工作目錄外的檔案（`blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`）。同時也支援強制停用略過權限模式（`disableBypassPermissionsMode`）。閘道設定檔還可透過 `telemetry.resource_attributes` 為登入與工作階段加上固定遙測標籤。若受管 MCP 伺服器的路徑包含目前桌面端不支援的開頭格式，閘道會直接拒絕啟動以確保安全。
body.en: When organizations uniformly configure development environments, the gateway's desktop policy block adds several control keys. Administrators can configure `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` to prevent reading files outside working directories. Enforcing `disableBypassPermissionsMode` to disable bypass permissions mode is also supported. The gateway configuration file can also add fixed telemetry labels to login and session traffic via `telemetry.resource_attributes`. If a managed MCP server path begins with a format that current Claude Desktop does not support, the gateway refuses to start to ensure safety.

items.original:
Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in `desktop` policy blocks, including `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` and `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
Added `telemetry.resource_attributes` to the Claude apps gateway config, to put fixed labels on the telemetry of Claude Desktop and `/login` sessions
Changed Claude apps gateway to refuse to start when a `managedMcpServers` entry's `envHelper` path starts with `\??\` or `/??/`, a path form current Claude Desktop refuses to run

title.zh-TW: 新增 attribution 設定，可隱藏提交與 PR 的署名資訊
title.en: Added attribution setting to hide commit and PR attribution

items.original: Added `"attribution": false` in `settings.json` to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions

title.zh-TW: MCP 支援 URL 模式引導，伺服器可請求開啟瀏覽器流程
title.en: MCP adds URL-mode elicitation so servers can request browser-based flows

body.zh-TW: 當外部服務需要你透過網頁完成登入或授權時，採用 2026-07-28 協定版本的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器現在能主動要求 Claude Code 開啟瀏覽器畫面。如果伺服器本身無法確認後續的完成狀態，終端機也不會留下一直卡住的等待對話框。⟦好比點餐機顯示網頁付款連結，手機直接跳出結帳畫面，櫃檯螢幕不會一直轉圈等待。⟧
body.en: When external services require you to complete login or authorization on the web, MCP servers on the 2026-07-28 protocol version can now ask Claude Code to open a browser screen. If the server cannot confirm subsequent completion, the terminal avoids leaving a stuck waiting dialog on screen. ⟦Think of an ordering kiosk displaying a web payment link so your phone opens the checkout screen directly, without leaving the counter display stuck in a loading loop.⟧

items.original: Added MCP URL-mode elicitation on 2026-07-28 protocol connections, so servers can ask Claude Code to open a browser-based flow; no waiting dialog is left on screen when the server has no way to confirm completion

title.zh-TW: 立即發送改將執行中工具轉入背景，不再中斷對話輪次
title.en: Send now moves running tools to background instead of cancelling turns

body.zh-TW: 當你發現 Claude 還在執行耗時的指令，但你手邊已經想好後續的追問或新任務時，只要按下快捷鍵（Ctrl+Enter 或 Ctrl+X Ctrl+S），正在跑的工具就會被平順轉移至背景默默運作。你不需要等它完全跑完，也不會因為搶先輸入而把先前的對話輪次強行中斷，讓工作節奏更為順暢。⟦彷彿在廚房燉湯的同時走進客廳交代同事下一份報表，瓦斯爐照常慢火細熬，你也不用站在爐邊乾等。⟧
body.en: When Claude is executing a time-consuming command and you have already prepared follow-up questions or new tasks, pressing a shortcut (Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+X Ctrl+S) smoothly transitions running tools to the background. You do not have to wait for them to finish, and typing ahead will not abort the prior conversation turn. ⟦A chef simmers soup on the stove while stepping into the living room to hand off the next report to a colleague, letting the pot bubble quietly without forcing anyone to wait by the burner.⟧

items.original: Changed send now (ctrl+enter or ctrl+x ctrl+s) to move running tools to the background instead of cancelling the turn

title.zh-TW: 自動模式審查擴及唯讀指令，並提供權限節省推薦
title.en: Auto mode review covers read-only commands and recommends permission savings

body.zh-TW: 想要放手讓工具自動執行任務，自動模式（auto mode）在啟用伺服器端分類器時，現在連唯讀與沙盒內的指令也會經過伺服器審查，只要被標記有疑慮就會主動阻擋。直接連線 Anthropic API 的使用者能透過環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 加入審查。此外在終端機輸入 `/insights` 能估算自動模式近期為你的工作階段省下了多少次手動確認。
body.en: For hands-free tool execution, auto mode with the server-side classifier enabled now routes read-only and sandboxed commands through server review, actively blocking them if flagged. Direct Anthropic API connections can opt in to review via `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1`. Entering `/insights` in the terminal also estimates how many manual confirmations auto mode saved in your recent sessions.

items.original:
Added an auto mode recommendation to `/insights` that estimates how many permission prompts auto mode could have handled in your recent sessions
Changed auto mode so that, where its classifier review runs server-side, read-only and sandboxed shell commands also wait for that review and are blocked when it flags them
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER` to also apply on a direct Anthropic API connection: `0` opts out of the server-side auto mode classifier (the local classifier then counts toward usage), `1` opts in

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改進重啟快取複用與拒絕意圖理解
title.en: Auto mode improves restart cache reuse and denial intent handling

body.zh-TW: 在中斷後重新接續工作階段（session）時，自動模式的權限分類器現在會直接重複使用先前的 Prompt 快取。這項機制把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接使用，省下重複計算的等待時間。此外當你拒絕某個危險動作時，Claude 現在會理解你拒絕的是「該項結果」而不只是那一行特定字眼，不會換個同義指令又重複嘗試相同的操作。⟦像吩咐管家不要買某款點心，他明白你的意思是別吃那道甜品，而不是換一間超商再去買回來。⟧
body.en: When resuming a session in a new process after an interruption, the auto mode permission classifier now directly reuses its earlier prompt cache. This saves time by retrieving cached computation. When you deny a dangerous action, Claude now understands you are rejecting the intended outcome rather than only the specific line of phrasing, avoiding repeated attempts with synonymous commands. ⟦Tell a butler not to buy a certain pastry, and he understands you want to avoid that dessert altogether rather than visit another convenience store to bring it back.⟧

items.original:
Improved auto mode after resuming a session in a new process: the permission classifier can now reuse its earlier prompt cache instead of rewriting it
Improved the auto mode denial message so Claude treats a denial as covering the outcome, not only the exact command

title.zh-TW: 加強刪除指令防護，新增變數路徑檢查與自動逾時拒絕
title.en: Enhanced deletion protection adds variable path checks and timeout denials

body.zh-TW: 當工具在自動模式或略過權限模式下準備執行帶有變數替換的刪除指令時（例如 `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`），現在一律會停下來向你確認，不再直接放行。如果目標路徑是變數接頂層目錄或純反斜線，安全防護也會主動攔截。在無人看守的工作階段中，確認視窗等待 2 分鐘後會自動拒絕並附上改寫提示，避免整台工作站因為等待使用者按鍵而永久卡死。
body.en: When tools in auto or bypass permissions mode prepare to run recursive deletion commands containing variable substitution, such as `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`, they now pause to ask for confirmation instead of running unprompted. Safety protections also flag targets where a shell variable is followed by a top-level directory name or contains only a backslash. In unattended sessions, the confirmation prompt waits 2 minutes before automatically denying the command with a rewrite hint, preventing workstations from hanging indefinitely on unhandled keystrokes.

items.original:
Fixed a recursive `rm` whose target is only command-substitution output, such as `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`, running unprompted in auto and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` mode; it now asks even with a Bash allow rule, unless run with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT=1`
Improved the dangerous-rm check to also flag a removal at a shell variable followed by a top-level directory name, at a variable derived from the working directory, or at a backslash-only target
Changed the dangerous `rm` prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode to wait 2 minutes for an answer, then deny the command with a rewrite hint so unattended sessions keep going (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1` turns this off)

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器改用檔案傳遞系統提示詞，並加強指令檔統計
title.en: Self-hosted runners use files for system prompts and count instruction files

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流水線中自建執行器時，極長的系統提示詞現在能改用 `--system-prompt-file` 傳遞私有檔案路徑，解決文字過長導致啟動失敗的問題。同時啟動時的提示詞大小警告會將 `@` 引入的所有關聯說明檔案一併合計。而在無頭模式（沒有終端機視覺畫面的模式）下，透過 `--add-dir` 額外掛載的資料夾也不會再把規則檔案重複傳送給模型。
body.en: When building self-hosted runners for automation pipelines, long system prompts can now be passed as private file paths via `--system-prompt-file`, preventing launch failures from oversized command-line text. Startup prompt size warnings also count all related instruction files and `@`-imports together. In headless mode, mounted directories added via `--add-dir` no longer send duplicate rule files to the model.

items.original:
Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules files from an `--add-dir` directory inside the working directory being sent to the model twice in headless and SDK sessions
Improved the large CLAUDE.md startup notice to also count instruction files together, so many mid-sized files and @-imports are caught
Changed self-hosted runners to pass system prompts to Claude Code as private files instead of command-line text, so large prompts no longer fail the launch; a wrapper or `command` hook that appends `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` must switch to `--system-prompt-file` or `--append-system-prompt-file`

title.zh-TW: 修復恢復工作階段時格式變更導致先前推理遺失的問題
title.en: Fixed resumed sessions dropping reasoning due to changed message format

body.zh-TW: 接續先前未完成的對話時，多項恢復工作階段（session）的邏輯獲得了徹底修正。以前平行工具呼叫、MCP 重新連線或中斷載入時，容易重複傳送格式變形的對話紀錄，導致 API 丟失先前的推理脈絡。現在超大工作階段不會再只恢復最後幾則訊息，在權限確認中途重啟也不會破壞快取暫存，而在工具執行中斷時手動恢復更不會偷塞隱藏訊息。這些損壞的歷史紀錄在啟動時都會自動修復完成。
body.en: Multiple session resumption mechanisms have been thoroughly overhauled when resuming incomplete conversations. Previously, parallel tool calls, MCP reconnects, or interrupted turns could resend modified conversation history, causing the API to drop prior reasoning context. Oversized sessions no longer restore only their last few messages, restarts during pending permission prompts no longer break prompt caching, and manual resumes after interrupted tool calls no longer insert hidden messages. Damaged history records are now repaired automatically at startup.

items.original:
Fixed resumed sessions re-sending earlier turns in a changed form (a parallel tool-call turn, an MCP tool call's input or a tool-search result while its server was still reconnecting, or a tool-search result whose loading turn was interrupted), which could make the API drop the conversation's prior reasoning
Fixed resuming a very large session sometimes restoring only its last few messages
Fixed a session resumed after a restart during a pending permission prompt sending a different history than before, which broke the prompt cache from that point
Fixed resuming a session that ended during a tool call: Claude now sees the call and is told its outcome is unknown, and a manual resume no longer adds a hidden "Continue" message
Fixed sessions with an earlier advisor result the API could no longer read failing one request every turn and repeatedly losing earlier reasoning; the history is now repaired once

title.zh-TW: 改善長工作階段與已壓縮對話的恢復速度與快取還原
title.en: Improved resume speed and cache restoration for long compacted sessions

body.zh-TW: 處理大型專案與長篇對話時，工作階段（session）的載入效率獲得了顯著提升。重新打開讀取過大量檔案的紀錄時，還原檔案快取（把先前讀過的檔案內容暫存起來直接使用）的速度明顯加快，且內容與先前讀取時完全相符。在 Agent SDK 與桌面端中恢復已經過壓縮的超長對話也更加順暢。若開頭的第一則提示詞極長導致超出長度上限，系統現在會將該則提示詞獨立進行摘要修復，確保對話能正常接續。
body.en: Session loading efficiency is significantly improved when handling large projects and long conversations. When reopening sessions that read many files, restoring the file cache is much faster, and contents match the files exactly as they were read. Resuming compacted long sessions in the Agent SDK and Claude Desktop is also smoother. If a massive first prompt triggers a prompt length limit, the system now summarizes that prompt on its own during recovery to keep the conversation going.

items.original:
Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files; the restored file cache now matches the files as they were read
Improved the time to resume very long sessions that have been compacted, most noticeably through the Agent SDK and Claude Desktop
Improved "Prompt is too long" recovery in sessions dominated by one very large first prompt: that prompt is now summarized on its own instead of being left out of the summary

title.zh-TW: 修復串流中斷與代理伺服器提早關閉連線時的重試與狀態遺失
title.en: Fixed stream drops and state loss from premature proxy disconnects

body.zh-TW: 連線經過企業代理伺服器或閘道時，串流傳輸的容錯機制更加健全。以前串流連線正常關閉時可能被誤判為已完成回應，重複事件甚至會導致工具被重複執行兩次；現在中途掉包時會妥善保留已抵達的部分內容與搜尋結果。此外修復了 API 請求重試期間介面當機、斷線後重複發送空白請求，以及結尾附帶純用量資訊時遺失結束原因的錯誤，確保工作階段（session）的連線穩定可靠。
body.en: Streaming fault tolerance is strengthened when connecting through enterprise proxies or gateways. Previously, a stream cleanly closed by a proxy could be mistaken for a complete response, and duplicate events could trigger tool calls twice. Dropped stream events now properly preserve partial responses and web search results that have already arrived. Fixes also resolve interface crashes during API request retries, duplicate empty requests after dropped connections, and lost stop reasons when trailing frames contain only usage data.

items.original:
Fixed a crash ("unrecoverable interface error") that could end a session while an API request was being retried
Fixed the prompt cache being lost when an MCP server disconnects mid-conversation, or is still connecting after a resume, while tool search is off (for example behind a proxy or gateway)
Fixed responses cut short by a proxy or gateway that closes the stream cleanly being shown as complete with no warning, and tool calls running twice on duplicated stream events
Fixed responses failing with "Content block not found" when a proxy drops a stream event mid-response; the partial response is now kept, and web search keeps results that already arrived
Fixed an empty completed response being requested twice when the connection dropped before the stream's final event
Fixed the stop reason being lost when a proxy sends a trailing usage-only frame

title.zh-TW: 修復 API 重試循環、限流等待與 HTML 錯誤頁面解析
title.en: Fixed API retry loops, rate limit waits, and HTML error parsing

body.zh-TW: 遇到模型輸出截斷與工具呼叫解析失敗交替出現時，對話輪次不再無視最大輪數限制無休止重試。重試看門狗機制在工作階段遭遇伺服器錯誤時不會再無限制靜默等待。快速模式收到 `Retry-After: 0` 時也不會緊接著瘋狂重發。此外代理伺服器回傳 HTML 格式的 429 或 502 錯誤頁面時，終端機會正確提取狀態碼，不再整段印出原始標記語法。
body.en: When unparseable tool calls alternate with output-limit truncation, turns no longer retry indefinitely while ignoring `--max-turns`. The retry watchdog in `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` sessions no longer sleeps silently and uncapped on server errors. Fast mode also stops firing rapid back-to-back retries upon receiving `Retry-After: 0`. When proxies return HTML error pages for 429 or 502 codes, the terminal extracts the HTTP status rather than printing raw markup.

items.original:
Fixed a turn that could retry indefinitely, ignoring `--max-turns`, when the model alternated unparseable tool calls and output-limit truncation
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` sessions failing on the first 5xx or dropped connection after a run of 429/529 waits, and sleeping uncapped and silently on a long `Retry-After` from a 5xx
Fixed fast mode retrying rate-limited requests back to back when the server sent `Retry-After: 0`
Fixed `/model` showing the raw API error JSON and request ID when the API refuses the picked model; it now shows the server's message and says the model was not changed
Fixed API errors from an HTML error page (such as a proxy's 429 or 502 page) printing the page's raw markup or leaving out the HTTP status, and error messages breaking onto a second line when the server's error text ended in a newline

title.zh-TW: 修復工具回傳超大圖片、過長名稱與記憶體讀取失敗的卡住問題
title.en: Fixed tool hangs from oversized images, long names, and memory reads

body.zh-TW: 呼叫外部工具處理多媒體或繁重工作時，多項邊界情況的穩定度獲得了加強。當執行的工具回傳超大尺寸圖片時，修復了導致同批次其他工具無人回應且持續空轉的問題。同時解決了模型呼叫超過 200 字元的工具名稱造成對話永久卡死、系統檔案描述符耗盡時因無法讀取記憶體用量而誤報工具失敗，以及讀取或提及大於 3 MB 的 PDF 檔案時延遲甚至背景渲染無法中斷的情況。
body.en: Edge case stability is strengthened when invoking tools for multimedia and heavy workloads. When a tool returns an oversized image, sibling tool calls in the same batch no longer hang unanswered or abandon the turn. Fixes also resolve conversations getting permanently stuck when tool names exceed 200 characters, false tool failures when memory usage cannot be read due to exhausted file descriptors, and delays or uncancelable background page rendering when reading PDFs larger than 3 MB.

items.original:
Fixed a tool that returned an oversized image leaving sibling tool calls unanswered and still running, or ending the turn with no final message
Fixed conversations getting permanently stuck on "tool_use.name: String should have at most 200 characters" after the model called a tool by an overlong name
Fixed tool calls failing with "Failed to get memory usage", or being reported as failed after they ran, when Claude Code cannot read its own memory usage, for example when it has run out of file descriptors
Fixed a delay of up to two minutes before responding when reading or @-mentioning a PDF larger than 3 MB
Fixed an interrupted Read of specific PDF pages leaving its page render running for up to two minutes

title.zh-TW: 修復檔案工具包含空字元路徑與重複參數名稱時的處理錯誤
title.en: Fixed file tool handling for null-byte paths and duplicate parameters

body.zh-TW: 在程式碼編輯過程中呼叫各類檔案處理工具時，多項參數驗證邏輯得到了修正。在使用讀取、寫入或編輯檔案工具時，如果路徑中意外混入了空字元（null byte），現在會明確回報工具執行失敗，不再直接中斷整個對話輪次。此外寫入工具在收到以不同參數名稱傳入但內容與路徑完全相同的呼叫時，也不會再直接拒絕執行。⟦宛如郵差看到寫錯格式的信封時會退件說明原因，而不是直接罷工回家。⟧
body.en: Parameter validation logic has been corrected across multiple file handling tools during code editing. When using Read, Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit, file paths containing a null byte now fail with a clear error instead of aborting the entire turn. Write calls that provide identical path and content values across two duplicate parameter names are also no longer rejected. ⟦A mail carrier returns a misaddressed envelope with an explanatory note rather than going on strike and walking home.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Read, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit: a file path containing a null byte now fails that tool call with a clear error instead of ending the whole turn
Fixed Write refusing a call that gives the file path or content twice under two parameter names with identical values

title.zh-TW: 修復沙盒排除指令比對錯誤，並指引本機網路連接埠綁定
title.en: Fixed sandbox command exclusion matching and added port binding guidance

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 沙盒環境中開發時，如果本機開發伺服器無法綁定通訊埠，Claude 現在會主動引導設定 `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding`。同時修復了沙盒排除指令無法正確比對特定 Git 指令與帶有標籤的提交訊息、自訂暫存路徑時沙盒內無法寫入的問題，以及權限規則中包含空字元被誤展開為萬用字元與存取特定網路掛載路徑的安全性問題。
body.en: When developing inside the macOS sandbox, Claude points to `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding` if a local development server fails to bind a port. Fixes also correct sandbox `excludedCommands` matching for specific Git commands and tagged commit messages, resolve `$TMPDIR` write failures when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is customized, and prevent permission rules with NUL bytes from expanding into wildcards or accessing network mount paths.

items.original:
Fixed permission dialogs and attachment checks reading a path under macOS's `/.vol`, `/.nofollow` or `/.resolve` (which can reach a network mount) before approval
Fixed a permission rule containing a NUL byte being expanded into a wildcard match; such a rule now matches nothing
Fixed sandbox `excludedCommands` entries not matching `git rev-parse --git-dir`, programs named like shell builtins, and commit messages containing `[WIP]` or `#` lines
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to `$TMPDIR` when `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR` is set
Improved sandbox guidance on macOS: when a local dev server can't bind a port, Claude now points to `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding`

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 伺服器重複連線、掛鉤等待與無頭模式握手停滯
title.en: Fixed duplicate MCP connections, hook waits, and headless handshake hangs

body.zh-TW: 在無頭模式（沒有終端機視覺畫面的模式）下與主機端 MCP 伺服器連線時，若主機在握手中途無回應，遠端工作階段現在最多只會等待數秒便自動恢復。同時掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）遇到阻塞事件時會確實等待伺服器連線。並修復了相同伺服器因網址大小寫或結尾斜線不同而連線兩次，以及另一個行程登入後狀態列未同步的問題，進一步提升連接工具時的可靠度。
body.en: When connecting to host-side MCP servers in headless mode, remote sessions now wait only a few seconds before recovering if the host stops responding mid-handshake. Blocking event hooks also wait for MCP server connections before firing. Fixes also resolve duplicate connections caused by URL casing or trailing slashes, and sync status bar login indicators when authenticating from another process.

items.original:
Fixed headless sessions with host-side (SDK) MCP servers stalling on the first message when the host stops responding mid-handshake; remote sessions now wait a few seconds at most
Fixed the "Not logged in · Run /login" footer and missing claude.ai connectors persisting in a session after logging in from another Claude Code process
Fixed `mcp_tool` hooks on blocking events (PreToolUse and similar) being skipped while their MCP server was still connecting; they now wait for it, up to the MCP connect timeout
Fixed the same MCP server being connected twice when a plugin or claude.ai connector and a configured server spell its URL differently (host letter case, default port, trailing slash)
Fixed `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0` giving up on claude.ai connectors after 1s instead of honoring `MCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`

title.zh-TW: 過濾 MCP 應用程式介面資源，並改善附件重複下載與螢幕報讀
title.en: Filtered MCP app resources and improved attachment caching and screen readers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中透過 `@` 提及或列出 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）資源時，清單會主動略過純 UI 專用的應用程式資源，避免干擾主要提示詞。在遠端控制連線中，工作階段內已下載過的附件會直接重複利用連線與暫存檔，不再浪費頻寬重複抓取。而在使用螢幕報讀軟體瀏覽 `/mcp` 清單時，停用的伺服器狀態會明確朗讀為關閉而非等待中。
body.en: When listing or `@`-mentioning MCP resources in the terminal, resource lists skip MCP Apps UI resources to keep prompts clean. Remote Control connections reuse sockets and cached files for previously downloaded attachments in the session, saving bandwidth. Screen readers navigating the `/mcp` list also announce disabled servers clearly as "off" rather than "pending".

items.original:
Improved screen-reader output in `/mcp`: a disabled server is read as "off" instead of "pending"
Changed Remote Control attachment downloads to reuse connections and to skip files already downloaded in the session
Changed MCP resource lists (the resource list tool and @-mention suggestions) to skip MCP Apps UI resources; reading one by URI still works

title.zh-TW: Plugin 新增 MCP 驗證檢查，並修復專案範圍管理指令
title.en: Plugins add MCP validation checks and fix project-scope management commands

body.zh-TW: 開發或安裝擴充外掛時，執行 `claude plugin validate` 現在會主動檢查 `.mcp.json` 中被略過的項目、未宣告的使用者設定變數與不安全網址，且不再將隱私權或支援網址誤判為未知欄位。同時修復了解除安裝專案範圍外掛時誤報啟用中、更新時省略 `--scope` 誤用使用者範圍，以及從含有市集檔案的目錄載入外掛時載入空白外掛的問題。
body.en: When developing or installing plugins, running `claude plugin validate` now checks for dropped `.mcp.json` entries, undeclared `${user_config.*}` variables, and insecure URLs, without mistaking privacy or support URLs for unknown fields. Fixes also resolve uninstall errors for project-scope plugins reporting as enabled, prevent omitted `--scope` update flags from defaulting to user scope, and fix empty plugin loads from directories containing marketplace files.

items.original:
Added MCP server checks to `claude plugin validate`: it reports `.mcp.json` entries that would be silently dropped at load, undeclared `${user_config.*}` references, and insecure URLs
Fixed `--channels` plugin entries being checked against the installed plugin's marketplace alone; the installed plugin's name must now match the entry as well
Fixed `--plugin-dir` on a folder of plugins that also has a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` loading one empty plugin instead of the plugins in it
Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` refusing to remove a project-scope plugin that isn't enabled, saying it is "enabled at project scope" while `claude plugin disable` says it is already disabled
Fixed `claude plugin update` failing for project-scoped plugins when `--scope` is omitted — it now resolves the scope the plugin is installed at instead of assuming user
Fixed `claude plugin validate` reporting `privacyPolicyUrl`, `supportUrl` and other listing metadata keys in plugin.json as unknown fields

title.zh-TW: Plugin 錯誤時顯示所屬名稱，加強掛鉤路徑與市集快取
title.en: Plugins name offending packages on errors and improve hook paths and caching

body.zh-TW: 在外掛生態系中除錯與管理套件時，錯誤回報機制變得更加明確。當外掛中的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行失敗時，錯誤訊息現在會明確點名是哪一個外掛出問題。驗證工具也會在指令未替路徑加上雙引號時發出警告，避免路徑含有空白字元時壞掉。此外市集在連線失敗並保留本機副本時不會誤記為已重新整理，解除安裝時若檔案因其他外掛使用而保留也會清楚說明。
body.en: Error reporting is clearer when debugging and managing plugin packages. When a plugin hook fails, error messages name the offending plugin directly. The validator also warns if shell hooks leave `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` unquoted, avoiding breaks on paths with spaces. Marketplaces that keep local clones on connection failure are no longer marked as refreshed, and uninstall routines explain when files remain because other plugins use them.

items.original:
Fixed `known_marketplaces.json` recording a marketplace as refreshed when its remote could not be reached and `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` kept the existing clone
Improved plugin hook-failure errors to name the offending plugin, and added a `claude plugin validate` warning when a shell-form hook leaves `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` unquoted (it breaks on plugin paths with spaces)
Changed `claude plugin uninstall --json` and the /plugin dialog to say a plugin's data was kept when its folder stays because another installed plugin uses it or install records cannot be read

title.zh-TW: 改進 Plugin 清單排版與捲動，修復市集更新與錯誤頁面確認
title.en: Improved plugin list layout and scrolling, and fixed marketplace updates

body.zh-TW: 在終端機打開 `/plugin` 管理介面時，已安裝外掛清單現在會依狀態、名稱、類型與詳細資訊分欄整齊對齊，方便你一眼看清各個套件的狀態。滑鼠滾輪能正確捲動清單內容而不影響底層畫面。同時修復了連按 Enter 觸發兩次更新或解除安裝、按住 y 鍵瞬間誤加市集，以及錯誤分頁在排除所有問題後沒有顯示確認提示的狀況，讓管理與瀏覽擴充套件時的操作更加順暢安定。
body.en: Opening `/plugin` in the terminal aligns installed plugins into neat columns for status, name, type, and details. Mouse wheel scrolling navigates the list smoothly without moving background panes. Fixes also prevent repeated Enter presses from triggering duplicate updates or uninstalls, stop held `y` keys from instantly adding marketplaces before prompts can be read, and show confirmation prompts after resolving all items on the Errors tab.

items.original:
Fixed the `/plugin` Errors tab showing no confirmation after its last error is resolved
Fixed `/plugin` starting a second uninstall or update of the same plugin when Enter was pressed again while the first was still running
Fixed a `y` held while `/plugin` checks a marketplace source adding the marketplace the instant the "Add marketplace?" question appears, before it can be read
Fixed the mouse wheel over the `/plugin` Installed list scrolling the pane behind it instead of the list
Fixed lists such as a skill's state options in `/plugin` not being answerable by typing a number in screen-reader mode
Improved the /plugin Installed list: rows now line up in columns (status, name, type, details) across every section

title.zh-TW: 工作階段成品收納為底部按鈕，並改進頁面文案與壓縮上傳
title.en: Session artifacts collapse to footer pills with improved copy and compression

body.zh-TW: 對話中產生的所有成品現在會在輸入框下方整合為單一膠囊按鈕（例如 `⧉ name`）。點擊該按鈕即可打開 `/artifacts` 清單查看本次工作階段的所有產出。成品設計技能現在會要求 Claude 生成更精準直白的說明文字；在慢速網路發布較大成品時會自動啟用壓縮傳輸，並允許載入外部公開腳本，在遠端控制工作階段中也不會再遺失成品工具。
body.en: Artifacts generated during conversations are now consolidated into a single footer pill below the prompt (such as `⧉ name`). Clicking it opens the `/artifacts` menu to view all outputs from the session. The artifact design skill asks Claude for direct, plain prose, large artifact uploads over slow connections are automatically compressed, scripts from unpkg.com are allowed, and Remote Control sessions retain the Artifact tool.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool missing from Remote Control sessions that `claude remote-control` starts for you to open from Claude Desktop, claude.ai or the mobile app
Improved the writing in published artifact pages: the bundled artifact-design skill now asks Claude for plain, direct prose
Improved artifact publishing on slow connections: large page uploads are now sent compressed
Changed the session artifact links under the prompt into one footer pill (`⧉ name` or `⧉ N`) that opens `/artifacts`, which now lists this session's artifacts first
Changed the Artifact tool to let Claude load scripts from unpkg.com in artifact pages

title.zh-TW: 修復雲端與遠端工作階段的背景代理回報、定時任務與重試迴圈
title.en: Fixed background agent reports, scheduled routines, and retry loops

body.zh-TW: 遠端執行長任務時，修復了背景代理剛完成就遇到工作單元重啟導致結果未告知 Claude 的問題。同時排程任務與 `/loop` 在派送失敗時不會再每秒無休止重試導致程式結束。修復了權限確認重疊時介面卡在待核准狀態、定時輪次在第一個工具呼叫前遺失開頭通知，以及遠端控制在組織原則載入中誤報已停用的情況，保障長時無人值守任務順利推進。
body.en: For long-running remote workflows, cloud sessions now report finished background agents to Claude even if worker restarts occur immediately after completion. Scheduled tasks and `/loop` wakeups no longer retry every second upon delivery failure, preventing Claude Code from exiting at turn end. Fixes also resolve interfaces stuck on "needs approval" during overlapping prompts, deliver missing turn-start notices on scheduled turns, and avoid false policy-disabled notices while org policies load.

items.original:
Fixed remote sessions staying on "needs approval" with a stale prompt after a permission prompt and a sandbox network-access prompt overlapped and both were answered
Fixed cloud sessions not telling Claude about background agents that finished just before a worker restart
Fixed scheduled routine and notification turns in remote sessions not receiving turn-start notices (newly available tools, MCP changes, date, todos) until after the first tool call
Fixed scheduled tasks and `/loop` wakeups being fired again every second when their delivery failed, which could make Claude Code exit at the end of a turn
Fixed Remote Control reporting "disabled by your organization's policy" when the org policy simply hadn't loaded yet; it now retries the fetch and says it couldn't verify

title.zh-TW: 修復 macOS 鑰匙圈鎖定時遺失憑證，並最佳化互動式啟動耗時
title.en: Fixed macOS keychain credential loss and optimized interactive startup time

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 睡眠喚醒或登入鑰匙圈鎖定時，寫入新憑證不再會意外遺失既有的 MCP 授權令牌（token，用來驗證身分的授權憑據）或刪除項目。雲端身分更新背景程序結束時會確實釋放通訊埠。啟動時也將 Git 讀取與模型升級檢查移至首格畫面渲染之後，並停止對無法成功的原則請求進行無效重試，讓終端機工作階段更快進入可用狀態，有效減少開機等待時間。
body.en: On macOS, writing credentials while the keychain is locked or right after wake no longer drops stored MCP OAuth tokens or deletes keychain entries. Cloud authentication refresh processes release localhost ports upon exit. Interactive startup defers Git reads and model-upgrade checks until after the first frame renders, while stopping unexecutable policy retries to make terminal sessions ready faster.

items.original:
Fixed macOS credential writes dropping stored MCP OAuth tokens or deleting the keychain entry when the login keychain was locked (e.g. right after wake)
Fixed `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` login processes being left running (and holding their localhost callback port on Windows) when Claude Code exits or the refresh times out
Improved Claude Desktop sign-in and usage-limit error messages to point at the app instead of terminal commands
Improved startup: managed settings and policy fetches no longer retry requests that can never succeed
Improved interactive startup time: git reads, startup telemetry and the Bedrock/Vertex model-upgrade checks no longer run before the first frame
Improved debug logs to name settings `env` variables ignored because the session's launch environment already sets them

title.zh-TW: 修復子工作階段繼承設定來源，並加強背景工作區信任檢查
title.en: Fixed setting source forwarding for sub-sessions and checked workspace trust

body.zh-TW: 透過 `claude --bg` 啟動背景工作階段時，如果目錄尚未通過工作區信任確認，現在會主動要求確認而非直接執行專案掛鉤。透過 `--setting-sources` 指定的設定限制現在會完整傳遞給衍生出的隊友與背景工作階段。同時修復了非互動模式下工作目錄被刪除引發的錯誤，以及未設定外掛時啟動不必要等待受管設定網路請求的問題。
body.en: Launching background sessions via `claude --bg` now checks workspace trust before running project hooks instead of executing unprompted. Settings restrictions set via `--setting-sources` are forwarded to teammate, `/bg`, and worktree sessions. Fixes also resolve errors in non-interactive sessions when directories are deleted mid-session, and eliminate startup waits on managed settings requests when no plugins or MCP servers are configured.

items.original:
Fixed `--input-format stream-json` sessions (Agent SDK, VS Code extension) and scheduled cloud sessions failing every turn with an error when an earlier assistant message had plain-string content
Fixed non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) failing on the next turn after the directory they were started in was deleted mid-session
Fixed interactive startup waiting on the managed-settings network request (about 80 ms, 17+ seconds when the network is unreachable) when no MCP servers or plugins are configured
Fixed `claude --bg` starting a background session, and running its project hooks, in a directory that had not passed the workspace trust prompt; it now asks for trust first, or exits when not run interactively
Fixed `--setting-sources` (and SDK `settingSources`) not being forwarded to spawned sessions: teammates, `/bg`, `claude agents` sessions and `--worktree --tmux` now start with the parent's restriction

title.zh-TW: 多代理支援讀取 JSON 檔案，批次執行支援自訂工作樹掛鉤
title.en: Multi-agent loads JSON files and batch execution supports worktree hooks

body.zh-TW: 使用 `--agents` 啟動多代理時，現在能直接指定 JSON 檔案路徑並允許空白提示詞。打 `/batch` 時即使不在 Git 倉庫內，只要有工作樹（worktree，平行開啟多份副本的功能）建立掛鉤提供目錄也能正常執行。此外從網頁端同步的技能清單會以簡短名稱顯示，深度研究（`/deep-research`）在長篇摘要上的穩定度也獲得提升。
body.en: Launching multiple agents via `--agents` now accepts a path to a JSON file and permits an empty prompt. Running `/batch` works outside Git repositories as long as a WorktreeCreate hook provides agent worktrees. Synced skills from claude.ai display by their short names, and `/deep-research` improves reliability on long research briefs.

items.original:
Improved `--agents` to accept the path to a JSON file (with `-p`) as well as inline JSON, and to allow an empty `prompt`
Improved `/batch` to run where a WorktreeCreate hook provides the agent worktrees, not only inside a git repository
Improved the `/` menu, `/skills`, `/context` and the `/plugin` Installed list to show skills synced from claude.ai by their short name when no other command uses it, not `anthropic-skills:<name>`
Improved `/deep-research` reliability on long research briefs by removing unused required fields from the scope step's output
Removed the leftover "(removed)" `/agents` entry from the command menu and `/help`; typing `/agents` still explains where the wizard went

title.zh-TW: 修復 Vim 模式按鍵動作，改進排隊訊息與文字貼上呈現
title.en: Fixed Vim mode key actions and improved queued messages and pasted text

body.zh-TW: 在終端機使用 Vim 編輯模式時，修復了 `dj`、`cw`、`1G` 與點號重複插入等多項游標與按鍵行為異常，避免帶有驚嘆號的文字誤切換至 Shell 模式。在 Claude 思考中途排隊送出的訊息現在會固定顯示在載入動畫上方並保留編輯器選取範圍。單行文字貼上在多數情境下也不會再被意外換行打散，讓命令列輸入體驗更加順暢自然。
body.en: When using Vim mode in the terminal, fixes correct motion behaviors for `dj`, `cw`, `1G`, and dot repeat inserts, preventing exclamation-mark text from mistakenly triggering shell mode. Messages queued while Claude is working now display above the spinner and preserve IDE selections. Single-line pasted text is no longer split across unexpected lines, creating a smoother command-line input experience.

items.original:
Fixed one-line pastes showing on their own lines in the sent message for prompts from VS Code or Remote Control and for expanded paste placeholders
Fixed a message queued while Claude is working losing or changing the IDE selection it was written with, and queued messages not showing their selection
Fixed vim mode: `dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` and their `c`/`y` forms acting on part of a line; `1G` going to the last line; `d0`/`c0`/`y0` doing nothing; the cursor being off by one after `.` repeats an insert; and `o`/`p` on a `!`-prefixed line switching to shell mode
Fixed vim mode `cw` on a space, an empty line, a word's last letter or a one-letter word also changing the next word; word motions stopping inside words in Hindi, Bengali and other scripts; and `.`, `p` or `P` that inserts text starting with `!` switching to shell mode, losing text or editing the wrong character
Fixed the prompt cursor moving one character too far after an accent typed as its own key
Changed queued messages to show in the conversation above the spinner instead of under it

title.zh-TW: 改進代理面板操作提示與焦點，更新背景工作列進度顯示
title.en: Improved agent panel hints and focus, and updated background progress row

body.zh-TW: 在終端機查看多代理面板時，底部提示鍵現在會如實反映自訂鍵盤對應，且不會在當前檢視的代理上重複提示切換按鍵。滑鼠點擊代理列會同步更新鍵盤游標，按下 Esc 鍵只會取消選取而不會誤中斷正在進行的對話。輸入框下方的背景工作列則新增了進度條、耗時與文字單位（token，AI 處理與計費的文字單位）統計，掌握背景任務的即時進度變得更加一目了然。
body.en: In the multi-agent panel, footer key hints reflect custom keybindings without showing redundant switch prompts for the active agent. Clicking an agent row updates the keyboard cursor, while pressing Esc deselects the highlighted row without interrupting running turns. The background workflow row below the prompt adds a progress bar, elapsed time, and token counts, making background task progress clear at a glance.

items.original:
Fixed the agent panel's footer hint ignoring keys rebound in `keybindings.json`, and showing a stray ` · ` when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound
Fixed the agent panel footer offering "Enter to view" and "x to stop" on the agent you are already viewing (where x types into its input), and "Enter to view" on the main row when main is already shown
Fixed a mouse click on an agent-panel row leaving the keyboard cursor on the previously selected row
Fixed Esc interrupting the running turn instead of deselecting the selected agent-panel row
Improved the background workflow row below the prompt: it now shows the name, a progress bar, the agent count on wide terminals, elapsed time, total tokens, and the large-workflow warning

title.zh-TW: 改進工作流程清單排版，終止重大檢視前新增防誤觸確認
title.en: Improved workflow list layout and added confirmation before stopping reviews

body.zh-TW: 打 `/workflows` 查看工作流程時，每一列改為以狀態圖示與耗時開頭，在窄終端機中會優先保留名稱與時間。當有新任務在背景啟動時，選取游標也不會突然跳移導致誤停其他任務。此外在 `/tasks` 清單中對正在執行的重大審查按下 x 鍵時，現在會先跳出確認提示，避免辛苦進行的任務進度被意外中斷，提供更安心的後台管理體驗。
body.en: Viewing workflows via `/workflows` leads each row with its status icon and elapsed time, preserving the run name and duration on narrow terminals. When new tasks launch in the background, the selection pointer no longer jumps unexpectedly. Pressing `x` on a running `/ultrareview` in the `/tasks` list now prompts for confirmation before stopping the task, preventing accidental interruptions.

items.original:
Fixed /workflows moving the pointer to a different run, and `x` stopping it, when a new run started while the list was open
Changed /workflows: each run's row leads with its status icon and elapsed time, and a narrow terminal keeps the run's name and time, dropping the agent and token counts first
Changed the background tasks list (`/tasks`): pressing `x` on a running `/ultrareview` now asks for confirmation before stopping the review

title.zh-TW: 統一對話框雙擊取消機制，加強權限確認與爆衝按鍵防護
title.en: Standardized double-press cancel across dialogs and protected rapid keystrokes

body.zh-TW: 在終端機打開各類彈出選單（如 `/hooks`、`/mcp`、`/memory`）時，連續按兩次 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 現在只會關閉當前對話框，不再直接退出整個程式。遠端輸入或快速切換視窗時的連發按鍵不會再誤觸上一個舊選項。修復了權限刪除確認中按下數字 1 誤刪目錄，以及連按 Shift+Tab 跳至錯誤權限模式的問題。
body.en: Opening dialogs such as `/hooks`, `/mcp`, or `/memory` in the terminal now closes the active dialog on a double press of Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D without exiting the application. Burst keystrokes from remote input or window switching no longer trigger stale selections. Fixes also prevent pressing 1 from accidentally confirming directory deletions in `/permissions` and stop rapid Shift+Tab presses from landing on wrong permission modes.

items.original:
Fixed `1` answering Yes in `/permissions`' delete and remove-directory confirms while the pointer is on No, which let a held `1` remove one workspace directory after another
Fixed pressing Shift+Tab twice quickly landing on the wrong permission mode
Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog in the remaining dialogs and pickers, such as `/memory`, `/hooks`, `/mcp` (including a server's sign-in screen), `/export`, `/copy`, `/theme`, and `/teleport`'s uncommitted-changes and login prompts (where Esc also quit)
Fixed keys that arrive in one burst of input (e.g. over Remote Control), such as an arrow key followed by Enter, `x` or `s`, acting on the previous selection: a stale effort level in `/effort` and the model picker, and the previously highlighted row in `/skills`, the background task rows under the prompt, MCP server prompts and `/install-github-app`
Improved `/install-github-app`, `/desktop`, the `/permissions` auto mode environment prompts, and the `/plugin` "Add marketplace?" and "Run this command?" prompts: they now use the standard dialog frame with key hints, and Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D cancels them on the second press like other dialogs
Improved the Remote Control confirmation: its options are briefly inactive again after the terminal window regains focus, so a key pressed while switching back cannot answer it

title.zh-TW: 修復反饋回報取消、環境重啟與多選提問工作階段名稱
title.en: Fixed feedback report cancellation, setup restarts, and session naming

body.zh-TW: 在傳送 `/feedback` 或 `/bug` 回報中途取消時，不會再把已取消的報告偷偷送出。修復了 `/setup-bedrock` 重新啟動以套用設定時導致終端機輸入錯亂或當機、設定檔中含有空值造成 `/config` 閃退、已啟動的編輯器被 `/ide` 誤判為未偵測到，以及 Claude 提出多選題時自訂的工作階段名稱意外消失的問題。
body.en: Cancelling `/feedback` or `/bug` reports mid-send no longer delivers the cancelled submissions. Fixes also resolve terminal crashes or garbled inputs when `/setup-bedrock` restarts to apply settings, prevent `/config` crashes when configuration files contain null values, fix undetected editor reports in `/ide`, and preserve custom session names when Claude asks multiple-choice questions.

items.original:
Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share still sending your report after you cancelled it while it was being sent
Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share failing every send with "Couldn't send feedback" after a Remote Control Stop arrived while the dialog was open
Fixed `/ide` showing "No available IDEs detected" while also listing a running IDE
Fixed the terminal being left in a broken state (crash or garbled input) when `/setup-bedrock` or `/setup-vertex` restarts Claude Code to apply new settings
Fixed `/config` exiting when `respectGitignore` or `copyFullResponse` in `~/.claude.json` holds `null`
Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks a multiple-choice question, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable

title.zh-TW: 修復模型思考開關顯示、上下文統計與暫存快照清理
title.en: Fixed model thinking switch display, context counts, and diff snapshots

body.zh-TW: 在無法關閉思考的模型上，按 Alt+T 或打開 `/config` 不再提供無效的思考開關，而是顯示單行說明保留開啟。打 `/context` 查看上下文用量時會將剛送出的最新訊息計入總額。安裝 GitHub 應用程式時若選擇略過更新不會再重複執行，執行 Bash 工具產生的暫存比對快照也會在結束時徹底清理乾淨，不再佔用硬碟空間。
body.en: On models where thinking cannot be disabled, pressing Alt+T or opening `/config` no longer displays an ineffective switch, showing a one-line explanation instead. Running `/context` now includes newly sent messages in the total count. Choosing "Skip workflow update" during GitHub app installation avoids rerun loops, and temporary Bash edit-diff snapshots are fully cleaned up on exit.

items.original:
Fixed Alt+T and `/config` offering to turn thinking off on models that can't; thinking now stays on there, with a one-line reason in place of the switch
Fixed `/context` total leaving out messages added since the last response; it now matches its categories and can read higher than the status line
Fixed `/install-github-app` updating the workflow after "Skip workflow update" was chosen, running setup twice on a repeated Enter, and ↑ on the repository step blocking a typed repository name when no repository was detected
Fixed `/heapdump` summary saying most memory is native when it is in the JS heap snapshot
Fixed Bash edit-diff snapshot directories piling up in the temp folder: abandoned ones are now deleted right away and the rest when Claude Code exits

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕清單新增捲軸，支援翻頁快捷鍵與滑鼠懸停
title.en: Fullscreen lists add scrollbars with paging shortcuts and hover highlights

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡安裝了許多套工具或外掛時，檢視畫面往往會超出單一螢幕高度。現在切換至全螢幕模式開啟 `/skills`、`/mcp` 或 `/plugin` 安裝清單時，右側會出現能用滑鼠直接點擊與拖拉的專屬捲軸，並支援 PgUp、PgDn、Home、End 與 j/k 鍵順暢翻頁。滑鼠游標移開後懸停亮色會即時淡出清除；在寬度受限的狹窄視窗中，長標籤也會自動以省略符號截斷以防版面錯位。
body.en: In fullscreen mode, viewing `/skills`, `/mcp`, or `/plugin` installed lists displays a clickable and draggable scrollbar on the right, supporting PgUp, PgDn, Home, End, and j/k navigation. Hover highlights clear immediately when the mouse moves away, and long rows truncate cleanly with ellipsis in narrow terminals to prevent layout issues.

items.original:
Added a scrollbar to the `/skills`, `/mcp` and `/plugin` Installed lists in fullscreen mode, like the one `/workflows` now has: it appears while the mouse is over the list and can be clicked or dragged
Fixed PgUp and PgDn doing nothing in a dialog's list (for example `/skills`) in fullscreen mode
Fixed the hover highlight lingering on a list row in fullscreen mode after scrolling or filtering moved it away from the mouse
Fixed long list rows, such as in the /remote-control menu, wrapping onto a second line in narrow terminals; they're now cut with …
Improved the `/workflows` and `/mcp` lists: they page (PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) and take j/k and the mouse like other lists, their arrows follow `select:previous`/`select:next` rebinds, and `x` in `/workflows` stops the run the pointer is on
Improved the `/plugin` plugin and marketplace details menus and the `/remote-control` already-connected menu: they now support Home/End and clicking a row

title.zh-TW: 改進分頁對話框鍵盤導覽，最佳化技能與掛鉤詳細資訊
title.en: Improved tabbed dialog navigation and streamlined skill and hook details

body.zh-TW: 在 `/permissions` 或 `/usage` 等多分頁對話框中，按上下鍵可自如地在上方分頁列與下方內容區切換焦點，停用終端機顏色時選中分頁依然保有醒目標示。`/skills` 清單改為名稱開頭並以圖示清楚標明開關狀態。查看 `/hooks` 詳細畫面時會直接說明掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）類型與修改位置，不再一律指向 settings.json 造成困惑。
body.en: In tabbed dialogs like `/permissions` and `/usage`, pressing the up and down arrows shifts focus between the tab bar and the content pane, keeping active tabs clearly highlighted even when terminal colors are disabled. The `/skills` list leads each row with the skill name and toggle icons. The `/hooks` detail view states the hook type and edit location directly rather than always pointing confusingly to settings.json.

items.original:
Fixed the selected tab in tabbed dialogs (`/config`, `/plugin`, `/permissions`) showing no highlight while the tab bar has focus when color is off (`NO_COLOR`)
Improved keyboard navigation in tabbed dialogs such as `/permissions` and `/usage`: ↑/↓ move focus between the tab row and the content, and a list responds to keys only while it has focus
Improved `/help` and `/sandbox`: ←/→ and Tab switch tabs from inside a tab's list, and ↓ on an empty Custom commands tab in `/help` no longer leaves the keys stuck until Esc
Improved `/skills`: each row now leads with the skill's name, with ✔ or ◯ alone showing on or off, and stays on one line in narrow terminals
Improved narrow list rows (`/skills`, `/workflows`, `/feedback`): a name keeps 20 columns beside its first detail, and details are shown whole or not at all
Improved `/hooks`: a hook's detail screen now says what kind of hook it is and where to change it, instead of always pointing at settings.json, and the hooks-disabled, safe mode and managed-hooks-only notices each say what is happening in one plain sentence

title.zh-TW: 修復清單數字編號與項目空行，改進檔案差異與伺服器列
title.en: Fixed list numbering and blank lines, and improved diffs and server rows

body.zh-TW: 在終端機顯示純數字開頭的清單項目時（如 `- 316.`），不再被誤轉為羅馬數字或錯誤字元；螢幕報讀與長清單中項目上方也不會再出現多餘空行。打 `/diff` 查看長變更清單時新增了位置捲軸且長路徑不換行。全螢幕模式下懸停清單列改為柔和底色調亮，`/mcp` 伺服器列則以專屬圖示開頭並精簡多餘資訊，整體終端機畫面呈現更乾淨清爽。
body.en: Displaying bulleted lists of plain numbers (like `- 316.`) no longer converts items into Roman numerals or incorrect characters, and extra blank lines above list items are removed in screen-reader and long lists. Running `/diff` on large changes adds a scrollbar and prevents long paths from wrapping. Fullscreen hover highlights tint the row gently, and `/mcp` server rows lead with status icons while streamlining trailing details for a cleaner display.

items.original:
Fixed an extra blank line above a list item whose text starts on the line after its bullet, in screen-reader mode, quoted lists and long lists
Fixed bulleted lists of plain numbers (like `- 316.`) showing as letters, roman numerals or the wrong numbers
Fixed `/hooks` and `/mcp` detail views printing a long value over the row below it in narrow terminals
Improved `/diff`: a scrollbar shows where you are in a long list of changed files, and long paths no longer wrap their rows
Changed hovering a list row in fullscreen mode, including in `/config`, to tint the row instead of drawing a second ❯ pointer beside the focused row's
Changed /mcp: each server's row now starts with its status icon and name, says its state once, and in a narrow terminal drops trailing facts like "managed" before shortening the name

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 環境下暫存目錄寫入權限與更新備份衝突
title.en: Fixed Windows temp directory permissions and update backup conflicts

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上使用 Bash 執行指令時，修復了寫入 `$TMPDIR` 暫存目錄時跳出權限不足（Permission denied）的錯誤。同時解決了多個 Claude Code 工作階段在同一瞬間進行版本自動更新時，因競爭條件互相刪除彼此的 `claude.exe` 備份檔，導致更新後執行檔遺失的問題。⟦好比兩位清潔人員在同一秒打掃置物櫃，一人清空回收桶卻不小心倒掉另一人剛放進去的備用鑰匙。⟧
body.en: When running commands with Bash on Windows, fixes resolve "Permission denied" errors when writing to the `$TMPDIR` directory. Fixes also eliminate a race condition where simultaneous Claude Code updates could delete each other's `claude.exe` backups, which could leave no executable behind after updating. ⟦Imagine two cleaners tidying lockers at the exact same second, where one empties the bin but accidentally tosses out the spare key the other just placed inside.⟧

items.original:
Windows: Fixed Bash commands that write to `$TMPDIR/…` failing with "Permission denied"
Windows: Fixed a race in which Claude Code sessions updating at the same moment could delete each other's `claude.exe` backup, which could leave no `claude.exe` behind

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件新增自動模式繼續提示，並修復工作階段開啟
title.en: VS Code extension adds auto mode prompts and fixes session loading

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 與 JetBrains 側邊欄中，當自動模式遇到計費分類器備援（fallback）時，現在會提供明確的 Continue 與 Stop 按鈕供你選擇。同時修復了開啟網頁版空白工作階段產生無法恢復的本機複本、伺服器未回傳歷史紀錄時工作階段無報錯空白開啟、擴充套件重啟後編輯器分頁無聲卡住，以及側邊欄中用量與費用文字折行被切斷的問題。
body.en: In VS Code and JetBrains side panels, auto mode provides explicit Continue and Stop buttons when falling back to billed classifier requests. Fixes also prevent empty web sessions from saving unresumable local copies, stop sessions from silently opening blank when server histories fail to load, unfreeze editor tabs after extension host restarts, and fix clipped cost and usage text on narrow sidebars.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Continue/Stop prompt in the VS Code and JetBrains panels when auto mode falls back to billed classifier requests, replacing the unanswerable warning line
[VSCode] Fixed opening a Web session with no messages saving an empty local copy that could not be resumed; an error now says where to continue it
[VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai/code session opening empty or with only part of its conversation, with no error, when the server failed to return its history, part of it failed to load, or a network sign-in page answered in its place; it now shows an error and can be opened again
[VSCode] Fixed conversations in editor tabs hanging silently after the extension host restarts; the tab now tells you to reopen it from the session list
[VSCode] Fixed Claude attaching option previews to multiple-choice questions in the chat panel, where the question card never shows them
[VSCode] Fixed the session manager's cost and usage block wrapping mid-text on a narrow side bar, and showing totals from a previous login after an account switch

title.zh-TW: Web 雲端工作階段新增快速模式開關，改進 GitHub 流程與錯誤提示
title.en: Web cloud sessions add Fast mode switch and improve GitHub workflows

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器中操作對話時，輸入區的模型選單新增了快速模式（Fast mode）切換開關。只要方案支援且模型具備對應能力，就能在雲端工作階段（session）中隨時切換。倉庫選擇器中新增了 GitHub 連線疑難排解連結。當 Pull Request 轉為草稿時能正確觸發定時排程，非 GitHub 倉庫會自動隱藏建立 PR 按鈕，開啟檔案失敗時的卡片也會清楚說明是檔案已不存在還是被權限規則封鎖。
body.en: When chatting in the browser, the composer's model menu adds a Fast mode switch, allowing toggling in cloud sessions at any time whenever supported by your plan and selected model. The repository picker adds a GitHub troubleshooting link. Pull requests converted to draft properly trigger scheduled routines, non-GitHub repositories hide the Create PR button, and failed file loads clearly indicate whether files are missing or blocked by permission rules.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added a Fast mode switch to the composer's model menu in cloud sessions, shown when your plan includes fast mode and the selected model supports it
[Claude Code on the web] Added a settings shortcut on the GitHub setup tip and a "Troubleshoot GitHub connection" link in the repository pickers, both opening your GitHub connection page
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed routines with a GitHub trigger for a pull request being converted to draft never firing; they now start a run when the pull request is converted
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud sessions on a repository that isn't hosted on GitHub showing a Create PR button that could never work; the button is now hidden there
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed the GitHub setup tip on claude.ai/code covering the repository picker's search box and rows while the picker is open; it now steps aside until the picker closes
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the file card shown when a cloud session can't open a file: it now says whether the file no longer exists or the session's permission settings block reading it

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 於 Slack 終止時新增通知，修復回覆停滯與當機自癒
title.en: Claude Tag in Slack adds stop notices and fixes reply stalls and crashes

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 討論串中有人按下 Stop 終止 Claude 的回覆時，討論串會主動留下一行訊息註明是誰叫停並提醒提及 `@Claude` 即可繼續。同時修復了頻道偶爾完全停止回覆討論串的問題（下次新訊息會自動恢復自癒）、按停後被背景任務喚醒誤重啟、任務中途當機時回覆嚴重延遲，以及工作階段設定過大時自動重啟失敗的說明提示。
body.en: When someone clicks Stop in a Slack thread to halt Claude's response, the thread leaves a short notice naming who stopped it and noting that mentioning `@Claude` will continue. Fixes also resolve channels permanently stalling on thread replies with self-healing on the next message, prevent background tasks from triggering unwanted restarts after stopping, eliminate delays after mid-task crashes, and clarify restart failures when session configurations are too large.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added a short line in the Slack thread after someone presses Stop, naming who stopped Claude's response and saying to mention @Claude to continue
[Claude Tag] Fixed Slack channels where Claude could permanently stop responding to replies inside threads; affected channels now recover on their own with the next new message to Claude
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude resuming a stopped request after you press Stop in Slack, for example when a check-in fired or a background task ended; messages sent mid-response are now read
[Claude Tag] Fixed Slack replies arriving many minutes late, or never, after Claude's session crashed mid-task, such as on a failed setup script; it now restarts on its own within minutes
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack promising an automatic restart, then failing generically, when a session's configuration is too large to start; the thread now says why and how to retry

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 改善長討論串上下文保留，修復企業網格頻道存取
title.en: Claude Tag improves long thread context and fixes Enterprise Grid channels

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 的超長對話中，Claude 不會再因為比對數週前的歷史紀錄而默默扣下回覆不發，在討論串深處重啟也不會遺失最近的上下文。同時修復了頻道從企業網格（Enterprise Grid）移至單一工作區或跨工作區共享頻道閒置後出現無法檢查頻道的錯誤。在討論串中詢問排程時，現在預設只列出該討論串專屬的定時任務，減少多餘的資訊干擾。
body.en: In long Slack conversations, Claude no longer silently withholds replies when evaluating against weeks-old history, and restarts deep inside threads retain recent context. Fixes also resolve channel check errors when channels move from Enterprise Grid org-wide sharing to single workspaces or experience quiet periods in shared channels. Inquiries about routines in a thread now list only that thread's scheduled tasks by default.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed very long Slack threads: Claude could silently withhold a reply after judging it against weeks-old messages, and a restart deep into the thread could lose recent context
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude answering every mention with "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a Slack channel moved from Enterprise Grid org-wide sharing into a single workspace
[Claude Tag] Fixed very large Enterprise Grid workspaces reached mostly through channels shared across workspaces getting "Couldn't check this channel" again after a quiet hour
[Claude Tag] Changed the routine list Claude gives when asked in a Slack thread to show that thread's own scheduled tasks by default instead of every routine in the channel

title.zh-TW: 修復 Claude Tag 推論掛鉤拒絕訊息、模型限制與雲端外掛設定
title.en: Fixed Claude Tag inference hook notices, model limits, and cloud plugins

body.zh-TW: 當 Slack 中的請求被組織設定的推論掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）阻擋時，討論串現在會直接印出掛鉤的具體拒絕原因且不再無效重試。切換模型時只會列出組織允許使用的模型清單。修復了連線 AWS 時 DynamoDB 與 Kinesis 帳號端點的驗證錯誤，管理員後台的外掛清單也會如實顯示外掛名稱而非原始代碼。
body.en: When a Slack request is blocked by an organization's inference hook, the thread displays the specific deny message and avoids useless retries. Switching models only lists and offers models approved by the organization. Fixes also correct authentication errors for DynamoDB and Kinesis account-based endpoints over AWS connections, and admin settings display plugin names instead of raw IDs.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack request blocked by your organization's inference hook showing a generic retry notice; the thread now shows the hook's deny message and Claude doesn't retry
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack offering to switch to models your organization can't use; it now lists and offers only models the switch will actually accept
[Claude Tag] Fixed requests to DynamoDB and Kinesis account-based endpoints failing to authenticate when sent through an AWS connection in Claude Tag
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Plugins sections in Claude Tag admin settings failing to load for organization admins and listing attached plugins as raw IDs; they now load and show each plugin's name

title.zh-TW: 修復程式碼審查重試時因強制推送導致未進行審查的問題
title.en: Fixed code review retries skipping reviews after force-push events

body.zh-TW: 在未設定為每次推送都觸發審查的儲存庫中，先前如果審查失敗重試期間發生了強制推送（force-push），該次 Pull Request 可能會被系統直接略過。現在這個問題已經修好，確保重試流程仍會如實完成審查，不會因為分支線路被強行覆蓋而漏掉重要的程式碼把關。⟦就像補考到一半考卷換了題目版本，監考老師依然會收卷改完，而不是直接當作這場考試沒發生過。⟧
body.en: In repositories not configured to review every push, pull requests could previously be skipped entirely if a force-push occurred while a failed review was being retried. This issue has been resolved, ensuring the retry flow completes the review reliably without dropping code inspection when branches are overwritten. ⟦If an exam question sheet gets replaced mid-test during a makeup exam, the proctor still collects and grades the paper rather than pretending the test never happened.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Fixed a pull request getting no review when its reviewed commit was force-pushed away while a failed review was being retried in a repository not set to review every push

title.zh-TW: Opus 5.5 上線並成為預設，Pro 方案改用 Opus
title.en: Opus 5.5 arrives as the default, and Pro plans switch to Opus

body.zh-TW: 沒特別指定模型的話，下次開 Claude Code 用的就是新一代旗艦 Claude Opus 5.5（`claude-opus-5-5`）。它是新的預設 Opus 模型，一次能讀 1M 上下文。價格是每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入 4 美元、輸出 20 美元。讀取快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）每百萬只要 0.20 美元。Pro 與 Team Standard 方案的預設模型也從 Sonnet 改為 Opus，與 Max、Team Premium 及 Enterprise 看齊。思考力度也有調整：以前存下的設定不再套用到 Opus 5.5 這類新模型；Opus 4.7、Opus 4.8 與 Fable 5 也不再讓出廠預設值覆蓋 `-p`、SDK、專案或設定檔的 `effortLevel`。
body.en: If you haven't picked a model yourself, the next time you open Claude Code you'll be on the new flagship, Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`). It is now the default Opus model and offers a 1M context window. Pricing is $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, with cache reads at $0.20 per million tokens. The default model for Pro and Team Standard plans has also changed from Sonnet to Opus, matching Max, Team Premium, and Enterprise. For thinking effort, settings saved in older versions no longer apply to new models like Opus 5.5. Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, and Fable 5 also no longer let their launch defaults override `effortLevel` configured via `-p`, the SDK, projects, or settings files.

items.original:
Added Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
Changed the default model on Pro and Team Standard plans from Sonnet to Opus, matching Max, Team Premium, and Enterprise
Changed an effort level saved before `/effort` became per-model to no longer apply to newly released models such as Opus 5.5; they start at their default until you pick a level
Changed Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 to stop holding their launch-default effort over `/effort` in `-p` or the Agent SDK, a project, managed or `--settings` `effortLevel`, or a per-model level

title.zh-TW: 寫檔先認清真實路徑，自動模式的安全檢查不再狂重試
title.en: File writes check the real path, and auto mode's safety check stops hammering retries

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 自己動手改檔、或開著自動模式的人，這批跟安全有關。透過符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）寫入檔案時，提示詞會明確指出實際寫入的落點位置。如果真實目標落在專案目錄外，`acceptEdits`、允許規則與自動模式都不再放行。在自動模式下，如果安全檢查拒絕審查某項操作，該操作會直接被拒絕一次，並提示重試沒有幫助。若安全檢查沒有任何回應，Claude Code 會逐步拉長重試間隔，連續十次無回應就會停止該輪對話並顯示說明訊息。模型呼叫 Write 工具時如果傳入 `path`、`file_text`、`file_content` 或多餘的 `description` 等非標準參數，也能正確通過驗證。
body.en: If you let Claude edit files on its own or run in auto mode, this batch is about safety. When writing to a file through a symlink, the prompt explicitly states where the write actually lands. If the real target sits outside the project directory, `acceptEdits`, allow rules, and auto mode will no longer approve it. In auto mode, if a safety check declines to review an action, the action is denied once with a notice that retrying will not help. If a safety check gives no response, retries now back off with increasing intervals, stopping the turn with an explanatory message after ten consecutive non-responses. In addition, Write tool calls that pass non-standard parameters such as `path`, `file_text`, `file_content`, or a stray `description` now pass validation properly.

items.original:
Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and `acceptEdits`, allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside
Fixed auto mode retrying an action over and over when a safety check declined to review it; the action is now denied once, noting that retrying won't help
Fixed auto mode denying actions over and over without pause when a safety check gave no answer; retries now back off, and the turn stops with a message after ten in a row
Fixed Write calls failing validation when a model sends `path`, `file_text`, `file_content` or a stray `description` instead of `file_path` and `content`

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕清單支援滑鼠滾輪，對話框按鍵一併修正
title.en: Fullscreen lists take the mouse wheel, and dialog keys get fixed

body.zh-TW:
在全螢幕裡捲清單、點選項，現在不必再跟對話框搶操作。你可以使用滑鼠滾輪捲動 `/skills` 清單，並點擊 `/plugin` 中的技能狀態選項。全螢幕下滾輪無法捲動含隱藏項目的清單（例如 `/model` 與 `/permissions`）已修復。在下列對話框中連按兩次 Ctrl+C 或 Ctrl+D 只會關閉對話框，不再退出程式：

```
/model, /effort, /config, /status, /usage, /plugin, /sandbox, /permissions,
/artifacts, /mobile, /login, /upgrade, /usage-credits, /install-github-app,
/setup-bedrock, /setup-vertex
```

點擊視窗喚回前景時，不再誤觸游標底下的搜尋器、分頁列、代理與工作流程列、指令連結或選單。對話框取消按 y 或 n 鍵直接確認關閉，改用 Enter 確認與 Esc 取消（可在 `keybindings.json` 綁定 `confirm:yes` 與 `confirm:no` 還原）；文字輸入框也不再因快捷鍵遺失輸入的英數或空白。
body.en:
Scrolling lists and clicking options in fullscreen no longer means fighting the dialogs. You can use the mouse wheel to scroll the `/skills` list and click on a skill's state options in `/plugin`. An issue where the wheel could not scroll lists with hidden items in fullscreen mode (such as `/model` and `/permissions`) has been fixed. Pressing Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D twice in the following dialogs now only closes the dialog instead of exiting the program:

```
/model, /effort, /config, /status, /usage, /plugin, /sandbox, /permissions,
/artifacts, /mobile, /login, /upgrade, /usage-credits, /install-github-app,
/setup-bedrock, /setup-vertex
```

Clicking a window to bring it to the foreground no longer accidentally triggers items under the pointer—such as search pickers, tab bars, agent and workflow rows, command links, or dropdowns. Dialogs no longer confirm or close on a stray y or n key, switching to Enter to accept and Esc to cancel (you can bind `confirm:yes` and `confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore this behavior). In addition, text input fields in dialogs no longer lose typed letters, numbers, or spaces to matching keybindings.

items.original:
Added mouse support to more lists in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the `/skills` list, and a skill's state options in `/plugin` can be clicked
Fixed Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D pressed twice in most dialogs (`/model`, `/effort`, `/config`, `/status`, `/usage`, `/plugin`, `/sandbox`, `/permissions`, `/artifacts`, `/mobile`, `/login`, `/upgrade`, `/usage-credits`, `/install-github-app`, `/setup-bedrock`, `/setup-vertex`) quitting Claude Code instead of closing the dialog
Fixed a click that only brought the terminal window to the front also triggering the item under the pointer — in search pickers, tab bars, agent/workflow rows, slash-command links and suggestion dropdowns
Fixed a stray `n` closing dialogs and a stray `y` confirming them; Enter and Esc accept and cancel (bind `y`/`n` to `confirm:yes`/`confirm:no` in `keybindings.json` to restore)
Fixed text fields in dialogs losing a typed letter, digit or Space to a keybinding on that key
Fixed the mouse wheel not scrolling selection lists with hidden options (such as `/model` and `/permissions`) in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: 輸入框、語音聽寫與暫存提示詞的一批修正
title.en: A batch of fixes for the input box, voice dictation, and stashed prompts

body.zh-TW: 送出前看不清自己打了什麼、聽寫按了停卻還在收音，這類小狀況這次一起修掉了。在 Windows 終端機中，按 Enter 清理不可見字元後會重新繪製畫面，讓你能看清楚送出的實際文字。不可見字元清理也不再誤刪波斯文與阿拉伯文用來連接字尾的零寬不連字元。語音聽寫時按下 Ctrl+C 會立即停止麥克風收音，在轉錄處理過程中按下 Esc 能順利取消，在轉錄檢視畫面與 vim NORMAL 模式下長按空白鍵也不會意外啟動聽寫。啟動掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行時按 Esc，或是編輯、倒帶讓提示詞回到輸入框時，IDE 選取的內容不會再遺失。使用 Ctrl+S 暫存的 `!` shell 模式提示詞，取回時依然維持 shell 模式，暫存後輸入 `/` 也能立即列出檔案路徑。
body.en: Can't see what you're about to send, or dictation still listening after you hit stop? Those small snags are fixed. On Windows terminals, the screen repaints after invisible characters are removed on Enter, letting you clearly review the exact text being sent. Invisible character cleanup also no longer removes the zero-width non-joiner used in Persian and Arabic text to attach suffixes. For voice dictation, pressing Ctrl+C stops microphone recording immediately, Esc cleanly cancels while a transcript is processing, and holding Space in the transcript view or vim NORMAL mode will not accidentally trigger dictation. IDE selections are no longer lost when pressing Esc while startup hooks run, or when editing or rewinding brings a sent prompt back into the input box. A `!` shell-mode prompt stashed with Ctrl+S remains in shell mode when restored, and typing `/` immediately lists file paths after stashing.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt line staying scrambled on Windows terminals after invisible characters were removed on Enter; the screen is now repainted so you review the exact text that will be sent
Fixed the invisible-character cleanup removing the zero-width non-joiner that Persian and Arabic text uses to attach a suffix to a Latin word or number, such as the plural of "PDF"
Fixed voice dictation not stopping on Ctrl+C (the prompt cleared but the microphone kept recording), Esc not cancelling while a transcript was processing, and held Space starting dictation from the transcript view and vim NORMAL mode
Fixed IDE selection being dropped when a sent prompt comes back into the input, such as pressing Esc to edit it, rewinding to it, or pressing Esc while startup hooks run
Fixed a `!` shell-mode prompt stashed with Ctrl+S coming back as a plain prompt when restored, and `/` listing file paths right after stashing one

title.zh-TW: 換模型不再讓快取失效，/cost 會說明快取為何沒命中
title.en: Switching models no longer breaks the cache, and /cost explains cache misses

body.zh-TW: 切換模型或接手子代理，最怕快取整個重算、白等一輪。當你在外部宿主應用程式中切換模型時，即使 Claude 正在執行任務，也不會再導致下一個提示詞發生快取未命中。外部宿主包含 Claude Desktop、VS Code 或 SDK。讀取快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，從分支復原的子代理會重新發送最初使用的工具清單，避免重建清單而破壞快取。`/cost` 指令說明快取沒命中的原因時，現在也會標出思考模式或思考顯示設定的變更。
body.en: Switching models or taking over a subagent used to risk a full cache recompute and a wasted wait. When switching models from an external host application while Claude is working, the next prompt will no longer suffer a cache miss. Supported host applications include Claude Desktop, VS Code, and the SDK. When reading cache, resumed fork subagents re-send the tool list they originally used rather than rebuilding the list, preventing cache breakage. In addition, cache miss explanations in the `/cost` command have been improved to explicitly identify changes in thinking mode or thinking display settings.

items.original:
Fixed a model switch made from a host app (Claude Desktop, VS Code, SDK) while Claude is working causing a prompt-cache miss on the next prompt
Fixed resumed fork subagents rebuilding their tool list instead of re-sending the one they first used, which broke prompt caching for that agent
Improved `/cost` cache-miss causes to name thinking mode and thinking display changes

title.zh-TW: 外掛更新支援 Git 憑證庫，冒充官方市集的名稱會被擋
title.en: Plugin updates work with Git credential helpers, and names posing as the official marketplace are blocked

body.zh-TW: 裝了外掛或技能的人，這次更新比較不會出錯。背景外掛市集自動更新現在支援 Git 憑證庫（存登入證明的地方），私有儲存庫市集不再每次都重新複製或無法更新。當你從追蹤分支或標籤的 GitHub 儲存庫或 Git 網址更新外掛時，`installed_plugins.json` 會更新為最新修訂版本，不再保留安裝時的舊紀錄。執行 `claude plugin update` 時，若官方市集的快照檔案為連結或體積過大，也不會再將外掛版本誤標為未知。技能這邊，當 `~/.claude/skills/` 內包含列出技能名稱的 `manifest.json` 時，該目錄下的技能不再被意外移入 `.trash` 資料夾。新增外掛市集時，名稱如果模仿保留的官方市集名稱會直接被拒絕，已新增的也會停止載入。
body.en: If you use plugins or skills, updating them is less error-prone now. Background plugin marketplace auto-updates now support Git credential helpers, ensuring private repository marketplaces no longer re-clone every run or fail to update. When updating plugins from a GitHub repository or Git URL tracking a branch or tag, `installed_plugins.json` updates to the latest revision instead of keeping the install-time commit. Running `claude plugin update` also no longer misidentifies plugin versions as unknown when the official marketplace snapshot file is a link or too large. For skills, items in `~/.claude/skills/` are no longer accidentally moved to the `.trash` folder when a `manifest.json` in that folder lists their names. Furthermore, adding a plugin marketplace whose name imitates a reserved official marketplace name is rejected immediately, and existing ones stop loading.

items.original:
Fixed `installed_plugins.json` keeping the install-time commit after updating a plugin from a GitHub repository or git URL that tracks a branch or tag
Fixed skills in `~/.claude/skills/` being moved to `~/.claude/skills/.trash/` when a `manifest.json` in that folder listed their names
Fixed background plugin marketplace auto-update ignoring git credential helpers, so private-repo marketplaces were re-cloned every run or never updated
Fixed `claude plugin update` clearing a plugin's recorded commit and moving it to version "unknown" when the official marketplace's snapshot file is a link or too large
Changed plugin marketplaces whose name imitates a reserved marketplace name to be refused when added, and to stop loading if one was already added

title.zh-TW: 圖示與顏色的一批修正：關閉的技能不再像載入失敗
title.en: Icon and color fixes: disabled skills no longer look like failed loads

body.zh-TW: 這批是畫面上的小圖示和顏色修正，看狀態時比較不會誤會。在淺色與 ANSI 主題下，工作階段意見回饋調查現在會正常顯示游標停留時的高亮效果。執行 `/workflows` 時，若只有一筆執行紀錄，會直接開啟該紀錄，不再短暫閃過單行清單。在 `/plugin` 與 `/skills` 中，關閉的技能改以暗色圓圈 ◯ 顯示，不再與載入失敗外掛的紅色 ✘ 混淆。多選選項的說明文字縮排位置已校正至標籤文字下方，不再縮排在選項編號底下。全螢幕模式下 `/plugin`、`/skills` 與 `/mcp` 的搜尋框右邊框不再遺失。伺服器有警告時在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器清單、詳細檢視畫面與 `/plugin` 中一律統一顯示為 ⚠ 圖示。
body.en: This batch fixes small icons and colors on screen, so statuses are harder to misread. On light and ANSI themes, the session feedback survey now properly displays hover highlights. Running `/workflows` with only a single execution record directly opens that run instead of briefly flashing a one-row list. In `/plugin` and `/skills`, disabled skills are now represented with a dim circle ◯, avoiding confusion with the red ✘ used for failed plugin loads. Multi-select option descriptions are now properly indented under the label text instead of under the option number. The search box in `/plugin`, `/skills`, and `/mcp` no longer loses its right border in fullscreen mode. Finally, servers with warnings now consistently display a ⚠ icon across the MCP server list, detail views, and `/plugin`.

items.original:
Fixed the session feedback survey showing no hover highlight on light and ANSI themes
Fixed `/workflows` briefly showing a one-row list before opening the only run
Fixed a skill you switched off showing the same red ✘ as a plugin that failed to load in `/plugin` and `/skills`; off now shows a dim ◯
Fixed multi-select option descriptions being indented under the option number instead of under the label
Fixed the search box in `/plugin`, `/skills` and `/mcp` losing its right border in fullscreen mode
Fixed `/mcp` showing △ in the server list but ⚠ in the detail view for the same server; the list, detail views and `/plugin` now all show ⚠

title.zh-TW: Home、End、PgUp 等按鍵在選單裡恢復正常
title.en: Home, End, PgUp and other keys work properly in menus

body.zh-TW: 按 End 想跳到清單最底、按 Tab 想換欄位，結果不是沒反應就是偷改了設定？在 `/config` 設定清單以及 `/model`、`/memory` 和權限提示等選單中，按 Home 與 End 鍵現在能正確跳至最頂端與最底端。在 `/skills` 選單中按 PgUp 與 PgDn 鍵時，選取游標會停在第一個或最後一個技能，不再循環繞回另一端。在 `/config` 清單中按 Tab 鍵不再默默更改選定設定的值，改為不觸發任何變更。全螢幕模式下的 `Ctrl+L` 與 `Cmd+K` 恢復原本的重繪畫面功能，不再清除轉錄檢視內容。`/autocompact` 的頁尾提示已更新為使用 `←` 與 `→` 調整數值，`/fast` 的頁尾也明確標示空白鍵為切換開關。
body.en: Pressed End to jump to the bottom of a list, or Tab to move on, only to get nothing or a silently changed setting? In the `/config` settings list, as well as selection lists such as `/model`, `/memory`, and permission prompts, pressing Home and End now jumps to the very top and bottom. In the `/skills` menu, pressing PgUp and PgDn stops the selection on the first or last skill rather than wrapping around. Pressing Tab in the `/config` list no longer silently changes the selected setting's value, instead doing nothing there. `Ctrl+L` and `Cmd+K` in fullscreen mode restore their original screen repainting behavior rather than clearing the transcript view. In addition, the footer hint for `/autocompact` now lists `←` and `→` for adjusting values, while the footer for `/fast` explicitly identifies Space as the toggle key.

items.original:
Fixed Home and End doing nothing in the `/config` settings list and in selection lists such as `/model`, `/memory` and permission prompts
Fixed PgUp/PgDn in the `/skills` menu wrapping past the first or last skill instead of stopping there
Fixed Tab silently changing the selected setting's value in the `/config` list; it now does nothing there
Reverted `ctrl+l` / `cmd+k` in fullscreen mode clearing the transcript view (added in 2.1.260); they redraw the screen again
Changed `/autocompact`'s footer hint to name ←/→, the keys that adjust other ordered values
Changed `/fast`'s footer to name Space as the toggle key

title.zh-TW: 工作階段紀錄損毀或格式不合時，對話不再報錯中斷
title.en: Damaged or malformed session records no longer break the conversation

body.zh-TW: 工作階段拖得越久，越怕一筆壞紀錄讓整段對話停擺。對話請求不再因為角色順序問題而拋出系統角色必須在助理訊息之前的 API 錯誤。開啟顧問模式時，若在不支援 `advisor_20260301` 標籤的代理伺服器或閘道後方遇到 API 400 錯誤，Claude Code 會自動拿掉該標籤重試。當工作階段儲存的歷史紀錄中包含無法載入的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具錯誤通知時，對話與 `/compact` 不再每輪報錯。當儲存的轉錄紀錄包含格式損毀的系統訊息或缺少檔案清單的記憶體儲存通知時，復原工作階段不再發生崩潰。全螢幕長工作階段若發生損毀，損壞的快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）訊息清單現在會自動重建，避免跳出無法復原的介面錯誤而中斷。
body.en: The longer a session runs, the more one bad record can threaten to stall the whole conversation. Conversations no longer fail on turn requests with an API error stating that role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message. When advisor mode is enabled behind a proxy or gateway that does not support the `advisor_20260301` tag, API Error 400 requests automatically retry without the tag. When saved session history contains a malformed notice about unloaded MCP tools, turns and `/compact` no longer fail on every turn. Resuming a session no longer crashes when its saved transcript holds a malformed system message or a memory-saved notice missing its file list. When long-running fullscreen sessions encounter corruption, damaged cached message lists are automatically rebuilt, preventing unrecoverable interface errors from aborting the run.

items.original:
Fixed conversations failing on every turn with a "role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message" API error
Fixed conversations with the advisor on failing every turn with API Error 400 "Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" behind a proxy or gateway that doesn't support it; the request now retries without it
Fixed a session failing on every turn and `/compact` when its saved history held a malformed notice about MCP tools that could not be loaded
Fixed a crash when resuming a session whose saved transcript holds a malformed system message or a memory-saved notice without its file list
Fixed one cause of long-running fullscreen sessions exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error": a damaged cached message list is now rebuilt

title.zh-TW: 設定檔被換掉或留著舊值時不再卡死
