title.en: Settings files no longer hang or crash on swaps and stale values

body.zh-TW: 讀設定檔讀到一半卡住不動，或一開 `/config` 就閃退？當設定檔或編輯後重新讀取的檔案在讀取過程中被具名管道替換時，Claude Code 不再無限期卡死等待。另一個是：某個設定項目已經移至 `settings.json`，但 `~/.claude.json` 中仍然殘留 `null` 或 `"false"` 等舊值時，開啟 `/config` 不會再發生崩潰，各項開關偏好也能被正確讀取。⟦像換了新手機，通訊錄裡還留著幾筆舊手機帶過來的空白聯絡人，以前一打開就閃退，現在照常打開、該讀的都讀得到。⟧
body.en: Stuck while reading a settings file, or `/config` crashing on open? When a settings file or a file being re-read after an edit is replaced by a named pipe mid-read, Claude Code no longer hangs indefinitely. In addition, when a preference has moved to `settings.json` while `~/.claude.json` still holds a legacy value like `null` or `"false"`, opening `/config` no longer crashes, and toggle preferences are parsed accurately. ⟦Picture a new phone that still carries a few blank contacts from the old one: the address book used to crash on them, and now it opens normally and reads everything it should.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude Code hanging when a settings file, or a file it re-reads after an edit, is replaced by a named pipe mid-read
Fixed `/config` crashing and some on/off preferences being misread when a preference that has moved to `settings.json` still holds a value like `null` or `"false"` in `~/.claude.json`

title.zh-TW: 背景子代理的訊息與報告不再遺失，Ctrl+C 按兩下就能退出
title.en: Background subagent messages and reports stop getting lost, and two Ctrl+C presses exit

body.zh-TW: 把工作丟給背景子代理（在背後替你跑任務的小助手）的人，這批修正讓交接不再掉東西。在無頭模式（沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）與 SDK 工作階段中，當背景子代理正在結束該輪對話時，傳送給它的訊息不會再默默遺失。當啟動子代理的主對話在讀取報告前執行了壓縮，已完成子代理的調查結果也不會再丟失。當 LSP 外掛啟用時，背景子代理現在能順利使用 LSP 工具進行程式碼語意分析。在背景子代理執行期間，按下兩次 Ctrl+C 即可順利退出，不再需要連續按三到四次。復原包含未完成背景代理、shell 或工作流程的工作階段時，不會再於你輸入前自行啟動模型對話。在非詳細模式下展開子代理交接訊息時，不再顯示內部的來源前言字串。
body.en: If you hand work to background subagents, these fixes stop things from getting lost in the handoff. In headless mode and SDK sessions, messages sent to a background subagent are no longer silently lost when the subagent is finishing its turn. If the conversation that launched a subagent is compacted before reading the report, the finished subagent's findings will no longer be dropped. Background subagents can now use the LSP tool for semantic code analysis when an LSP plugin is active. Pressing Ctrl+C twice now cleanly exits while background subagents are running, removing the need for three or four presses. Resuming a session with unfinished background agents, shells, or workflows will not start a model turn on its own before you type anything. In addition, expanding subagent hand-back messages outside verbose mode no longer exposes internal provenance preambles.

items.original:
Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing an internal provenance preamble when expanded outside verbose mode
Fixed resuming a session with unfinished background agents, shells or workflows starting a model turn on its own before you typed anything
Fixed messages sent to a background subagent being silently lost in headless and SDK sessions when the subagent was finishing its turn
Fixed a finished subagent's report being lost when the conversation that launched it was compacted before the report was read
Fixed background subagents being unable to use the LSP tool when an LSP plugin is active
Fixed Ctrl+C needing three or four presses to exit while background subagents are running; two presses now exit

title.zh-TW: 背景任務的一批修正：退出碼、空字元與暫存目錄
title.en: Background task fixes: exit codes, null characters, and temp directories

body.zh-TW: 背景跑的指令明明正常結束，畫面卻顯示失敗，或 `claude agents` 開起來一片空白，這幾種狀況修好了。背景 shell 任務回傳良性的非零退出碼（例如未找到匹配項的 grep 指令）時，不再被誤報為執行失敗。當傳入工作階段的環境變數中包含空字元時，背景工作階段 `claude --bg` 現在依然能正常執行 Git、掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）、外掛與其他輔助程式。當暫存目錄已滿、沒有寫入權限或屬於其他使用者時，執行 `claude agents` 會顯示明確的錯誤訊息，不再停留在無回應的空白畫面。跨工作階段通訊的啟動警告也做了說明改進，清楚指出可以使用 `--debug-file` 將除錯日誌寫入你指定的檔案路徑。
body.en: A background command that finished fine but showed as failed, or `claude agents` opening to a blank screen: those are fixed. When background shell tasks return benign non-zero exit codes (such as a grep command finding no matches), they are no longer reported as failures. When environment variables passed into a session contain NUL characters, background sessions running `claude --bg` can still execute Git, hooks, plugins, and helper programs normally. When the temp directory is full, lacks write permissions, or is owned by another user, running `claude agents` displays a clear error message instead of remaining stuck on a blank, unresponsive screen. Startup warnings for cross-session messaging have also been improved to explain that `--debug-file` writes debug logs to a path you choose.

items.original:
Fixed background shell tasks reporting benign non-zero exits (e.g. grep with no matches) as failures
Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`) being unable to run git, hooks, plugins and other helper programs when an environment variable handed to the session contained a NUL character
Fixed `claude agents` showing a blank, unresponsive screen instead of an error when the temp directory is full, not writable or owned by another user
Improved the cross-session messaging startup warning to explain that `--debug-file` writes a debug log to a path you choose

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具說明長度可以自己調，重新加回的伺服器直接連上
title.en: MCP description length is now adjustable, and re-added servers reconnect right away

body.zh-TW: 裝了很多 MCP 伺服器、或工具說明寫得特別長的人，這兩個改動跟你有關。你可以透過新增環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH`，自訂工作階段內所有 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的工具說明與指示文字長度，打破原先 2,048 個字元的預設限制。另外，以前用 `claude mcp remove` 移除 MCP 伺服器後，若以相同名稱重新新增該伺服器，介面可能會停留在需要認證的錯誤狀態；現在會直接重新連線，不必再手動登入一次。⟦就像便利貼的大小改成由你挑，工具說明不必硬擠在 2,048 字裡；拔掉再插回同一支隨身碟，電腦也會直接認得，不會再叫你重新登入。⟧
body.en: If you run lots of MCP servers or write long tool descriptions, these two changes are for you. You can now set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to customize the length cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions across every MCP server in the session, overriding the default 2,048-character limit. In addition, when an MCP server was re-added under the same name after running `claude mcp remove`, the interface previously remained stuck in an error state requiring authentication; the system now reconnects directly without requiring repetitive manual sign-ins. ⟦Think of it as picking your own sticky-note size, so tool descriptions no longer have to squeeze into 2,048 characters; and plugging the same USB stick back in gets recognized right away instead of asking you to sign in again.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH` to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session
Fixed an MCP server re-added under the same name after `claude mcp remove` still showing as needing authentication instead of reconnecting

title.zh-TW: Artifact 發布出問題會說明原因，網頁深色模式也補齊
title.en: Artifact publishing explains what went wrong, and dark mode now covers the whole page

body.zh-TW: 發布 Artifact 時，工具突然不見，或存取規則被悄悄重設？當組織政策因網路代理等因素無法載入時，Artifact 工具不再悄悄消失，Claude 現在會具體說明受阻原因。當重新發布 Artifact 時若遺漏了資料庫存取規則或檢視者個人檔案範圍，Claude 會直接拒絕發布，避免儲存的存取規則被意外重設或範圍遺失。當 Claude 無法讀取收到的 Artifact 連結時，會在繼續之前先告訴你。產出的 Artifact 網頁拿掉了列印按鈕、確認對話框以及檢視器阻擋的裝置功能，電子郵件與電話改以純文字呈現，深色模式也完整套用至表單控制項與捲軸。
body.en: Publishing an Artifact and the tool suddenly vanished, or your access rules quietly reset? When organization policies fail to load due to factors like web proxies, the Artifact tool no longer disappears silently; Claude now explicitly explains what is blocking it. When republishing an artifact, if database access rules or viewer profile scopes are omitted, the system actively refuses publication, preventing stored access rules from being accidentally reset or scopes from being dropped. If Claude cannot read an artifact link it received, it notifies the user before continuing. For generated artifact web pages, Print buttons, confirmation dialogs, and device features blocked by the viewer have been removed, email and phone details appear as plain text, and dark mode extends across form controls and scrollbars.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool silently disappearing when your organization's policy can't be loaded (for example behind a web proxy); Claude now says what's blocking it
Fixed artifact republishes silently resetting stored database access rules or dropping the viewer profile scope when that capability was re-sent without them; they are now refused
Improved the Artifact tool so that when Claude cannot read an artifact link it was given, it tells the user before continuing
Improved artifact pages: no Print buttons, confirm dialogs or device features the viewer blocks, email and phone details shown as text, and dark mode that reaches form controls and scrollbars

title.zh-TW: /ultrareview 與遠端工作階段的一批修正
title.en: Fixes for /ultrareview and remote sessions

body.zh-TW: 審查明明還在跑卻顯示已停止、雲端 runner 認證失敗就斷線，這類意外中斷少了很多。使用 `/ultrareview` 上傳審查時，金鑰與設定檔複本（如 `id_rsa copy` 或 `kubeconfig (1).yaml`）留在本機不上傳。若工作階段被刪除或帳號變更，`/ultrareview` 不再誤報已停止的審查，也不會死等至逾時。在 Claude 應用程式中，遠端操控與雲端工作階段在 `/compact` 或 `/clear` 後上下文用量即時更新；當分支同時有已提交與未提交變更時，diff 檢視不再遺漏已提交檔案。伺服器過載且存取 token（授權令牌）輪替時，雲端與自架 runner 不再因認證失敗中斷。Cowork 編輯逾 10,800 字元記憶體衝突時，重試寫入不再丟失中段內容。
body.en: Reviews shown as stopped while still running, or cloud runners dropping on auth failures: far fewer of these now. When uploading reviews with `/ultrareview`, renamed copies of key and config files (such as `id_rsa copy` or `kubeconfig (1).yaml`) remain on your local machine rather than being uploaded. If a session is deleted or the signed-in account changes, `/ultrareview` no longer misreports stopped reviews as completed or retriable errors, nor does it wait out the full timeout. In the Claude app, context usage figures for Remote Control and cloud sessions update immediately after `/compact` or `/clear`; when a branch has both committed and uncommitted changes, the diff view no longer drops committed files. When servers experience prolonged overloads during which access tokens rotate, cloud and self-hosted runner sessions no longer fail with authentication errors. When memory write conflicts arise in Cowork sessions for files exceeding about 10,800 characters, retried writes no longer drop the middle content.

items.original:
Fixed `/ultrareview` reporting a stopped cloud review as completed or as an error to retry, and waiting out the full timeout when its session was deleted or the signed-in account changed
Fixed the Claude app showing a missing or stale context usage figure for Remote Control and cloud sessions right after /compact or /clear
Fixed the Claude app's diff view for Remote Control and cloud sessions dropping a branch's committed files whenever there are also uncommitted changes
Fixed cloud and self-hosted runner sessions failing with "Authentication failed" after waiting out a long overload during which the session's access token was rotated
Fixed memory write conflicts in Cowork sessions showing Claude only the start and end of a memory file over about 10,800 characters, so the retried write dropped the middle
Improved `/ultrareview` uploads: renamed copies of key files, such as `id_rsa copy` or `kubeconfig (1).yaml`, now also stay on your machine

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤逾時會指名是哪一個，日誌也記下輸出大小
title.en: Hook timeouts name the culprit, and logs record output size

body.zh-TW: 自己寫掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的人，出問題時更好查了。OpenTelemetry 的 `hook_execution_complete` 事件中新增了掛鉤輸出大小，以及因超出限制而存入檔案的超大輸出數量記錄。當 `UserPromptSubmit` 掛鉤執行逾時，逾時提示訊息與除錯日誌中現在會具體指出是哪一個掛鉤指令發生逾時。在 `PermissionRequest` 掛鉤中，代理型別（agent-type）的掛鉤因無法做出允許或拒絕的判定而不再允許執行，介面會顯示錯誤並引導你改用指令型或 HTTP 型掛鉤。
body.en: If you write your own hooks, problems are now easier to track down. The `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event now includes hook output sizes and the count of oversized outputs saved to disk. When a `UserPromptSubmit` hook times out, the timeout notice and debug log now explicitly name which hook command timed out. In addition, agent-type hooks are no longer permitted in `PermissionRequest` hooks since their answers could never allow or deny requests; the interface now displays an error pointing to command or HTTP hooks.

items.original:
Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the `hook_execution_complete` OpenTelemetry event
Improved the UserPromptSubmit hook timeout notice and the debug log to name which hook command timed out
Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks: an agent-type hook no longer runs there, since its answer could never allow or deny the request; it now shows an error pointing to command or http hooks

title.zh-TW: 權限規則清單更好操作，刪除確認預設改成 No
title.en: The permission rules list is easier to use, and delete confirmations default to No

body.zh-TW: 權限規則一多、清單一長，最容易迷失的是游標停在哪裡。在 `/permissions` 中檢視、新增或刪除規則後，介面焦點會自動回到規則清單中，刪除規則與移除目錄的確認對話框預設選項也改為 No 以防止手滑誤刪；在規則清單中按下 `←`、`→` 與 Tab 鍵可直接切換分頁，無需將焦點移至分頁列。執行 `/install-github-app` 進行 GitHub CLI 檢查與儲存庫選取步驟時，畫面現在會顯示「按 Esc 取消」的提示。`/artifacts` 與 `/workflows` 清單右側新增了捲軸，方便看清長清單的隱藏範圍與目前所在位置。工作流程進度樹中正在執行的代理與階段圖示從 `⟳` 改為暗色圓點。
body.en: Once permission rules pile up and lists grow long, the easiest thing to lose track of is where your cursor sits. After viewing, adding, or deleting a rule in `/permissions`, focus returns to the rule list automatically, and confirmation dialogs for deleting rules or removing directories now default to No to prevent accidental deletions. Pressing `←`, `→`, and Tab within the rule list switches tabs directly without moving focus to the tab bar. Running `/install-github-app` now displays "Esc to cancel" during the GitHub CLI check and repository selection steps. Scrollbars at the right edge of `/artifacts` and `/workflows` lists make it easy to see how much of a long list is hidden and where you currently are. In addition, running agents and phases in the workflow progress tree now display a dim dot instead of `⟳`.

items.original:
Improved `/permissions`: focus returns to the rule list after viewing, adding or deleting a rule, and the delete-rule and remove-directory confirmations now default to No
Improved `/permissions` tab navigation: ←/→ and Tab pressed in a rule list now switch tabs without moving focus to the tab bar
Improved `/install-github-app`: the GitHub CLI check and repository selection steps now show "Esc to cancel"
Improved the `/artifacts` and `/workflows` lists: a scrollbar at the right edge shows how much of a long list is hidden and where you are in it
Improved the workflow progress tree: running agents and phases now show a dim dot instead of ⟳

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕排版對齊，打 @ 找檔案先列檔名相符的
title.en: Fullscreen layouts line up, and @ file search lists filename matches first

body.zh-TW: 打 `@` 想找某個檔案，結果先跳出一堆只是資料夾名稱剛好對上的檔案？在全螢幕模式下，`/plugin` 的新增市集表單不再於窗格內額外繪製方框，文字與按鍵提示與其餘介面完全對齊；`/workflows` 詳細檢視畫面在全螢幕下也不會在窗格分隔線下方繪製多餘的第二條水平分隔線。未指定語言的程式碼區塊現在會採用類似行內程式碼的顏色標註，使指令能從周圍文字中清楚凸顯。當你在工具仍在執行時透過 `/btw` 提出旁支問題，Claude Code 現在認得這個呼叫還在跑，不會將其誤判為失敗呼叫。在輸入 `@` 搜尋檔案時，檔案名稱直接符合搜尋詞的項目現在會優先排在僅資料夾名稱符合的項目之前。
body.en: Typed `@` to find a file, only to see files that merely sit in a matching folder listed first? In fullscreen mode, the Add Marketplace form in `/plugin` no longer draws an extra box inside the pane, aligning its text and key hints with the rest of the interface. The `/workflows` detail view in fullscreen mode no longer draws an extra horizontal line beneath the pane divider. Code blocks without a specified language are now styled with inline-code coloring so commands stand out distinctly from surrounding text. Asking side questions via `/btw` while a tool is still running now recognizes the call as in progress rather than misinterpreting it as failed. When searching files with `@`, entries matching the query in their file name rank above those matching only across folder names.

items.original:
Improved `/plugin`'s Add Marketplace form in fullscreen: it no longer draws a box inside the pane, and its text and key hints line up with the rest of `/plugin`
Improved the `/workflows` detail view in fullscreen: it no longer draws a second horizontal rule under the pane's divider
Improved code blocks that don't name a language: they are now colored like inline code, so commands stand out from the surrounding text
Improved `/btw` asked while a tool is still running: the side question now knows that call is in progress instead of reading it as a failed one
Improved `@` file suggestions: a file whose name contains the query now ranks above one that only matches across its folder names

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器與 Windows 清理的一批修正
title.en: Fixes for self-hosted runners and Windows cleanup

body.zh-TW: 用自己的機器替 Claude Code 跑工作（也就是自架執行器），或在 Windows 上把設定資料夾改指到別處的人，這批跟你有關。在 self-hosted runner 中，生命週期掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）提交在 `--configure-git` 下無法簽章已修復。執行器達到 `--retire-at` 即將退役時，會等待該輪對話回報完畢再停止工作階段，避免遺失信號。生命週期掛鉤中的 Git 忽略執行器共用 Git 檔案指定的目錄與程式，本機路徑與 `git://` 遠端現在需要設定 `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`。Windows 背景清理不再誤刪用於重定向 `~/.claude/session-env`、`image-cache` 等目標的目錄符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）或接合點。
body.en: If you run Claude Code work on your own machines (a self-hosted runner), or point settings folders elsewhere on Windows, this batch is for you. On self-hosted runners, lifecycle-hook commits failing to sign under `--configure-git` has been resolved. When a runner reaches `--retire-at` and is about to retire, it briefly waits for the turn to be reported before stopping the session, avoiding lost finish signals. Git inside lifecycle hooks now ignores hook directories and programs named in the runner's shared Git files, while local-path and `git://` remotes now require `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`. On Windows, background cleanup no longer deletes directory symlinks or junctions used to relocate `~/.claude/session-env`, `image-cache`, or other target directories.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed lifecycle-hook commits failing to sign under `--configure-git`
Windows: Fixed background cleanup deleting a directory symlink or junction used to relocate `~/.claude/session-env`, `image-cache` or another cleaned-up folder
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a turn that ended right at a `--retire-at` release losing its finished signal; the runner now briefly waits for the turn to be reported before stopping the session
Self-hosted runner: Changed git in lifecycle hooks to ignore hook folders and programs named in the runner's shared git files; local-path and `git://` remotes there now need `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL`

title.zh-TW: VS Code 多了六個斜線指令對話框
title.en: VS Code gains six slash-command dialogs

body.zh-TW: VS Code 使用者這次拿到一批新對話框。你現在可以在對話框輸入 `/status` 開啟狀態對話框，檢視工作階段的版本、帳號、模型與伺服器詳細資訊；輸入 `/sandbox` 或從面板選單開啟沙盒對話框，管理沙盒模式、非沙盒備援與排除指令；輸入 `/chrome` 開啟 Claude in Chrome 對話框，查看擴充功能狀態、安裝、重新連線、權限頁面與預設啟用設定。輸入 `/export` 可將對話複製或儲存為純文字；輸入 `/skills` 開啟 Slash 指令對話框，能查看各個技能的來源、預估 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量與啟用狀態，並可直接點擊切換；輸入 `/plan` 則可切換至計畫模式、發送第一個計畫提示詞或查看目前計畫。
body.en: VS Code users get a batch of new dialogs this time. You can type `/status` to open the Status dialog, inspecting session version, account, model, and server details. You can type `/sandbox` or open the Sandbox dialog from the panel menu to manage sandbox mode, unsandboxed fallbacks, and excluded commands. You can type `/chrome` or open the Claude in Chrome dialog from the panel menu to view extension status, installation, reconnection, permissions pages, and the enabled-by-default setting. In addition, typing `/export` copies or saves the conversation as plain text. Typing `/skills` opens the Slash commands dialog to check each skill's source, token estimate, and on/off state with click-to-toggle support. Typing `/plan` switches to plan mode, sends a first planning prompt, or views the current plan.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Status dialog, with a typed `/status`, showing the session's version, account, model and server details
[VSCode] Added a Sandbox dialog for the sandbox mode, the unsandboxed fallback and excluded commands, opened from the panel menu or by typing `/sandbox`
[VSCode] Added a Claude in Chrome dialog (extension status, the install, reconnect and permissions pages, the enabled-by-default setting), opened from the panel menu or by typing `/chrome`
[VSCode] Added Export conversation, with a typed `/export`, to copy or save the conversation as plain text
[VSCode] Added each skill's source, token estimate and on/off state to the Slash commands dialog, with a click to change the state, and a typed `/skills` that opens it
[VSCode] Added a typed `/plan` that switches to plan mode, sends a first planning prompt, or shows the session's plan

title.zh-TW: VS Code 貼上長文字會自動標記，新分頁開在旁邊
title.en: VS Code marks long pastes, and new tabs open beside your editor

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 貼上一大段文字時，Claude 現在分得出哪些是貼的、哪些是你打的。在聊天輸入框中貼上超過 800 個字元或包含超過 2 個換行符號的文字時，會自動標記成貼上內容。貼上文字時若包含不可見的 Unicode 格式化與標籤字元，清掉後會跳提示，其餘文字中的不可見字元也會在發送前自動移除。點擊「在新分頁開啟」時，Claude 視窗現在會直接開啟在你當前編輯器群組的旁邊，不再排在最後一個群組之後。重新開啟工作階段後，你發送的訊息中不再殘留貼上標記線。
body.en: When you paste a big chunk of text in VS Code, Claude can now tell what you pasted from what you typed. When pasting text over 800 characters or containing more than 2 line breaks into the chat box, the text is automatically marked as pasted so Claude can distinguish it from what you typed. If pasted text contains invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters, the system notifies you after stripping them, and invisible characters in any other text are removed before sending. Clicking "Open in New Tab" now opens Claude right beside the editor group you are currently working in rather than after the last group. In addition, paste marker lines no longer linger in your own messages after reopening a session.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved pasted-text handling in the chat box: a paste over 800 characters or over 2 line breaks is now marked so Claude can tell it from what you typed
[VSCode] Improved prompt handling in the chat box: invisible Unicode formatting and tag characters are removed from pasted text with a notice, and from anything else before it is sent
[VSCode] Changed "Open in New Tab" to open Claude beside the editor group you are working in rather than after the last group
[VSCode] Fixed paste marker lines showing in your own messages after reopening a session

title.zh-TW: VS Code 思考力度即時顯示，Python 擴充套件卡住不再拖累啟動
title.en: VS Code shows live thinking effort, and a stuck Python extension no longer blocks startup

body.zh-TW: VS Code 裡幾個會卡住或顯示錯的地方修好了。思考力度標籤不再顯示過期的儲存數值，改為即時呈現工作階段實際執行的力度等級。當 Python 擴充套件在啟用過程中卡住時，Claude Code 不再永久等待，而是在 60 秒後略過 Python 環境直接啟動。在計畫審批卡片中，當自動模式可用時，第一個選項現在會正常提供「是，並使用自動模式」，與終端機體驗保持一致。從鍵盤封存或取消封存工作階段後，工作階段清單中的方向鍵導覽不會再中斷失效。
body.en: A few spots in VS Code that stalled or showed stale info are fixed. The effort chip no longer shows a stale saved effort level, instead displaying the actual level the session runs at in real time. When the Python extension hangs during activation, Claude Code no longer waits indefinitely, starting after 60 seconds without the Python environment. On the plan approval card, when auto mode is available, the first option now properly offers "Yes, and use auto mode", matching the terminal experience. In addition, arrow-key navigation in the session list no longer stops working after archiving or unarchiving a session from the keyboard.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the effort chip showing a stale saved effort level instead of the level the session runs at
[VSCode] Fixed Claude Code never starting when the Python extension hangs while activating; it now starts after 60 seconds without the Python environment
[VSCode] Fixed the plan approval card never offering auto mode: when auto mode is available, its first option is now "Yes, and use auto mode", as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed arrow-key navigation in the session list stopping after archiving or unarchiving a session from the keyboard

title.zh-TW: 例行任務設定搬到 Remote sessions，GitHub Enterprise 權杖自動續期
title.en: Routine settings move under Remote sessions, and GitHub Enterprise tokens renew automatically

body.zh-TW: 管理員找不到例行任務（排好時間自動跑的工作）的開關了？它換了位置。管理員的例行任務開關設定已移至「Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions」路徑下，Claude Code 管理頁面也附上了跳轉連結。在 GitHub Enterprise Server 儲存庫的雲端工作階段中執行 `gh` 指令與 GitHub API 呼叫時，存取 token（授權令牌）在約八小時後會自動續約，不再發生逾期中斷。若在排程執行前一刻編輯了例行任務，復原既有工作階段時會立即採用最新的提示詞與名稱，不再沿用舊設定執行。
body.en: Admins looking for the Routines switch: it moved. The admin Routines on/off setting has moved under "Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions", with a direct link added to the Claude Code admin page. When executing `gh` commands and GitHub API calls inside a cloud session on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository, access tokens renew automatically after about eight hours without expiring. In addition, if a routine is edited moments before its scheduled execution, resuming an existing session immediately applies the updated prompt and name rather than running with old settings.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin Routines on/off setting to live under Admin settings → Capabilities → Remote sessions; the Claude Code admin page now links to it
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls inside a cloud session on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository failing after about eight hours; the token now renews automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a routine that resumes an existing session running with its old prompt and name when it was edited moments before the scheduled run started

title.zh-TW: 網頁版雲端工作階段的一批修正
title.en: Fixes for cloud sessions on the web

body.zh-TW: 點了檔案連結卻一直轉圈，或審批沒回就被記成你拒絕？在雲端工作階段轉錄紀錄中，指向工作目錄以外的檔案連結若無法載入，現在會直接停用並明確說明原因，不再打開永遠載入中的空白檔案卡片。在自動模式下，若審批提示逾期未回覆或被新訊息取代，不再記成你主動拒絕，工具呼叫能正常進行後續重試。在 Claude 應用程式中檢視雲端工作階段時，Claude 現在會將專供你使用的檔案儲存在應用程式可開啟的位置。在管理員關閉 GitHub 的組織中於自架環境啟動工作階段時，介面不再顯示空的儲存庫選擇器。
body.en: Clicked a file link that just kept loading, or had an unanswered approval logged as your denial? In cloud session transcripts, file links pointing outside the working directory that fail to load are now disabled with an explanation, rather than opening a blank file card that never loads. In auto mode, if an approval prompt expires unanswered or is superseded by a newer message, it is no longer recorded as an active user rejection, allowing tool calls to retry normally. When viewing cloud sessions in the Claude app, Claude now saves files intended for you where the app can open them. In addition, starting a session on a self-hosted environment in an organization where an admin turned GitHub off no longer shows an empty repository picker.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in a cloud session transcript that point outside the session's working directory opening a file card that never loads; they're now disabled and say why
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed auto mode refusing to retry a tool call because an approval prompt that expired unanswered, or was superseded by a newer message, had been recorded as your rejection
[Claude Code on the web] Improved cloud sessions viewed in the Claude app: Claude now saves files meant for you where the app can open them
[Claude Code on the web] Removed the empty repository picker shown when starting a session on a self-hosted environment in an organization where an admin has turned GitHub off

title.zh-TW: Slack 裡看得到 Claude 做到哪，也能隨時按停
title.en: See Claude's progress in Slack and stop it anytime

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道把工作丟給 Claude 之後，你會想知道它做到哪了。Claude 在頻道討論串中回覆時，會顯示 Slack 原生的運作指示器、中斷按鈕與討論串標題；運作指示器會持續顯示直到任務完成，按下中斷按鈕可隨時中止執行。在訪客限制或僅限頻道設定下，當訪客加入或最後一名訪客離開而改變了 Claude 的回應方式時，頻道內會發出簡短通知說明變更。對於在加入 Enterprise Grid 之前就已連接 Claude 的 Slack 工作區，排程例行任務無聲失敗的問題已修復。
body.en: Once you hand work to Claude in a Slack channel, you want to know how far along it is. When Claude replies in channel threads, it displays Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button, and thread title; the indicator remains visible until Claude finishes, and pressing Stop interrupts the task at any time. Under Restrict or Channel only guest settings, when a guest joins or the last guest leaves and alters how Claude responds, a short notice is posted in the channel explaining the change. In addition, scheduled routines failing silently in Slack workspaces connected to Claude before joining Enterprise Grid have been fixed.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button and thread title to Claude's threads in channels; the indicator stays up until Claude finishes, and Stop interrupts the task
[Claude Tag] Added a short notice in the Slack channel when a guest joining, or the last guest leaving, changes how Claude responds there under a Restrict or Channel only guest setting
[Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines silently failing to run in Slack workspaces that were connected to Claude before the workspace joined its Enterprise Grid

title.zh-TW: Slack 檔案掃描會自動重試，錯誤訊息講出具體原因
title.en: Slack file scans retry automatically, and errors say what actually failed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 用 Claude 遇到錯誤時，現在比較知道是哪裡出問題。當遇到短暫的檔案掃描服務中斷時，Claude 不再要求你重新上傳檔案，而是會自動重試掃描並在掃描器離線時接收通知。在 Claude 的 Slack 回覆中，開頭帶有 `+`、`-` 或 `*` 符號的項目清單不再被錯誤渲染為空白項目符號與多餘的巢狀項目，文字內容與開頭符號完整保留為單一項目符號。當雲端環境設定指令碼執行失敗時，通知訊息不再僅顯示通用的重試提示，改為具體指出失敗的指令碼名稱並提示先修復問題。在管理員設定中，GitHub 連線橫幅現在會詳細說明未連線的具體原因，包括未登入、應用程式未連結或未安裝、登入逾期或 SSO 未授權。
body.en: When something goes wrong using Claude in Slack, it's now clearer where the problem is. When a brief file-scanning service outage occurs, Claude no longer asks you to re-upload files, instead retrying the scan automatically and receiving a notice if the scanner is down. In Claude's Slack replies, list items starting with `+`, `-`, or `*` are no longer rendered as empty bullets with stray nested items, properly preserving the text and character as a single bullet. When cloud environment setup scripts fail, the notice no longer displays a generic retry prompt, instead naming the failed script and advising you to fix the issue first. In admin settings, the GitHub connection banner now explains exact disconnection reasons, including not signed in, app not linked or not installed, sign-in expired, or SSO not authorized.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude asking you to re-upload a Slack file when a brief file-scanning outage, not the file, was the problem; it now retries the scan and is told when the scanner is down
[Claude Tag] Fixed a bullet in Claude's Slack reply whose text starts with +, - or * rendering as an empty bullet with a stray nested item; it now shows as one bullet with the character kept
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack notice for a failed cloud environment setup script sometimes being a generic "mention me to retry"; it now names the setup script and says to fix it first
[Claude Tag] Improved the GitHub banner in Claude Tag admin settings to say why GitHub isn't connected: not signed in, app not linked or not installed, sign-in expired, or SSO not authorized

title.zh-TW: REVIEW.md 太長被截掉時，Code Review 會告訴你
title.en: Code Review now tells you when REVIEW.md is too long and gets cut

body.zh-TW: 審查規範寫得太長，有一部分可能根本沒被讀到。當儲存庫中的 `REVIEW.md` 審查指示檔案因為超過大小限制而在程式碼審查過程中遭到部分裁切或完全忽略時，Code Review 檢查執行會明確發出通知，具體指出檔案名稱與大小限制上限。團隊看到就知道規範沒有完全生效，可以回頭調整檔案長度。⟦交稿給編輯時，稿子太長被砍掉一部分，以前編輯不會吭聲；現在會在稿子上註明砍到哪、上限是多少。⟧
body.en: If your review guidelines run long, part of them may never have been read at all. When a repository's `REVIEW.md` instruction file is partially cut or entirely omitted during code review because it exceeds size limits, the Code Review check run explicitly issues a notice naming the file and the exact limit. This allows teams to immediately understand why review guidelines did not take full effect and adjust instruction file lengths promptly. ⟦It's like handing an editor a manuscript that runs long: part of it used to get cut without a word, and now the editor notes what was cut and what the limit is.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review check run to say when REVIEW.md instructions were cut or left out of a review for exceeding a size limit, naming the file and the limit

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改採伺服器端分類器，省下額外判斷開銷
title.en: Auto mode switches to server-side classifier, saving extra evaluation overhead

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 在自動模式下處理任務時，現在不必再為背後的判斷多付一筆開銷。⟦這好比無人停車場的車牌辨識，進出時由遠端主機驗證放行且免收手續費，只有切換到人工備援窗口時才會提醒加收費用。⟧針對 Claude API、Enterprise 用戶，以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與各大閘道，自動模式已改為預設啟用伺服器端分類器。此機制不收取分類器的額外開銷；若退回計費的備援流程，系統會主動發出警告。只要輸入 `/status` 指令，即可在新增的 `Auto mode server` 資料列查看目前工作階段是否在伺服器端運行。若在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或閘道端想退出，將環境變數設為 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 即可。
body.en: When letting Claude handle tasks in auto mode, you no longer need to pay extra overhead for the underlying evaluations. ⟦It is like license plate recognition at an automated parking lot, where entry and exit are verified and cleared by a remote host with no processing fee, and extra charges are alerted only when switching to a manual fallback booth.⟧ For Claude API and Enterprise users, as well as Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and major gateways, auto mode now defaults to enabling the server-side classifier. This mechanism does not charge for classifier overhead, and the system actively warns if it falls back to a billed process. Simply run the `/status` command to check whether the current session is running on the server in the newly added `Auto mode server` row. To opt out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or gateways, simply set the environment variable to `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0`.

items.original:
Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server

title.zh-TW: 模型選單支援 GPT-6 系列，限流提示推薦切換 Luna
title.en: Model Picker Supports GPT-6 Series with Rate-Limit Prompts Recommending Luna

body.zh-TW: 當你連續請 AI 撰寫程式碼而發出大量請求時，最怕遇到對話中斷而打亂思緒。在模型選單（挑選由哪一款 AI 回答問題的切換清單）中，現在可以直接指定 GPT-6 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna。當發送的請求達到上限並觸發限流（短時間內發送過於頻繁時暫停接收的保護機制）時，畫面跳出的切換提示現在會主動推薦改用 GPT-6 Luna 接手。⟦如同騎長途公路車遇到陡坡時，碼表直接跳出該換哪一檔的建議，以前得自己停下來判斷，現在照著提示換檔就能繼續往前騎。⟧如此一來，在密集調度不同模型資源時，便能直接順著建議切換，不必中斷手邊正在進行的開發任務。
body.en: When sending numerous requests while asking AI to write code consecutively, unexpected interruptions that break your train of thought are a major hassle. From the model picker, you can now directly choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna. When outgoing requests hit their cap and trigger rate limits (a protective throttle that pauses incoming requests when sent too frequently in a short period), the pop-up switch prompt now proactively suggests handing off to GPT-6 Luna. ⟦Much like a cyclist on a steep climb whose bike computer now suggests which gear to shift into: before, you had to stop and work it out yourself; now you follow the prompt and keep riding.⟧ This ensures that when juggling model resources heavily, you can follow the suggestion to switch directly without interrupting your ongoing development work.

items.original: Choose GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna from the model picker. The rate-limit switch prompt now recommends GPT-6 Luna. (#47405)

title.zh-TW: 選用 /tui 全螢幕介面，支援搜尋紀錄與滑鼠右鍵複製
title.en: Choose the optional /tui fullscreen UI with transcript search and right-click copying

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕介面現在是可選的：在 Codex 裡輸入 `/tui` 做選擇，下次啟動時就會改用全螢幕的操作畫面。⟦好比走進挑高寬敞的大型閱覽室，桌面上能一口氣展開整份研究卷宗，想找特定段落直接查目錄，還能隨手拿螢光筆圈選重點並按一下印表機複印。⟧進入全螢幕後，你可以直接用搜尋功能快速翻查過往的對話轉錄紀錄，也能直接用滑鼠游標圈選畫面上的文字，並點擊滑鼠右鍵快速複製內容。
body.en: The fullscreen interface is now optional: enter `/tui` in Codex to select it, and your next launch will switch to a fullscreen operational display. ⟦Picture stepping into a spacious reading hall where you can spread out an entire research dossier across the desk, look up specific passages directly in the index, highlight key notes with a marker, and make instant copies on a printer.⟧ Once in fullscreen mode, you can quickly search through past conversation transcripts, select text on screen directly with your mouse cursor, and right-click to copy content quickly.

items.original: Choose an optional fullscreen UI with `/tui` for your next launch, including transcript search, mouse selection, and right-click copying. (#46732, #46734, #46883, #46895)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話改為預設開啟，附快捷鍵、設定選單與播放修復
title.en: Voice conversations are enabled by default with shortcuts, a settings menu, and playback fixes

body.zh-TW: 雙手忙著寫程式或翻查文件時，開口直接跟 AI 討論變得更自然省事。⟦就像車載免持對講系統在出廠時就預先安裝好喇叭與麥克風，按下方向盤按鈕就能隨時切換通話，而且遇到播放暫停或語音突然大量湧入時，車機喇叭依然會把每個字完整唸完，絕不漏字。⟧語音對話現在預設直接開放，Linux 與 Windows 版本也已內建打包好的音訊執行階段，開箱即可運作。你只要按下 F8 鍵就能開關語音對話，或在對話中輸入 `/voice settings` 開啟選單挑選偏好的語音設定。另外，系統修復了音訊播放暫停或短時間湧入大量語音時容易丟失字句的問題。
body.en: Speaking directly with AI becomes much more natural when your hands are busy writing code or looking through documentation. ⟦Much like a factory-installed hands-free car intercom with built-in speakers and microphones, you can toggle calls from the steering wheel, and the car speakers read out every word completely without dropping speech even during pauses or sudden bursts of incoming audio.⟧ Voice conversations are now enabled by default, and Linux and Windows builds bundle pre-packaged audio runtimes that work out of the box. Simply press F8 to toggle voice conversations, or type `/voice settings` in a conversation to open a menu and choose your preferred voice options. In addition, the system fixes an issue where speech was dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio.

items.original:
Voice conversations are enabled by default, with an F8 toggle, a `/voice settings` picker, and bundled audio runtimes for Linux and Windows. (#44921, #46071, #44622, #44714, #44922)
Prevent speech from being dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio. (#46880)

title.zh-TW: 新增 /usage 分析儀表板，用量、token 與外掛活動一目了然
title.en: Add /usage analytics dashboard to track consumption, token totals, and plugin activity

body.zh-TW: 想知道自己的帳號用掉多少額度、哪些外掛與技能最常派上用場？現在只要在終端機輸入 `/usage` 指令，就能叫出專屬的數據分析總覽。⟦宛如家庭智慧電表配備的即時數據面板，隨時翻看就能清楚查閱總耗電度數、各個家電插座的用電紀錄與每日用量走勢，不再需要等到月底收帳單才盲猜。⟧在這個儀表板中，你可以檢視帳號的整體用量，掌握消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）累積總計。同時，介面還會列出各項外掛與技能的呼叫活動紀錄，方便你評估各項擴充工具的運作情形。
body.en: Want to know how much quota your account has used or which plugins and skills are called most often? Now you can simply enter the `/usage` command in the terminal to bring up a dedicated analytics overview. ⟦Think of a smart home electricity meter equipped with a live dashboard that lets you check total kilowatt-hours, monitor power usage across individual appliance outlets, and track daily consumption trends instead of guessing before the bill arrives at the end of the month.⟧ In this dashboard, you can view your overall account usage and track cumulative token totals. The interface also lists invocation activity across plugins and skills, making it easy to evaluate how your extensions are performing.

items.original: Explore account usage, token totals, and plugin and skill activity through the `/usage` analytics dashboard. (#45764, #45769)

title.zh-TW: 代理人控制中心支援狀態篩選，工作樹建立與支援預設開啟
title.en: Agent command center supports status filtering, with worktree creation and support enabled by default

body.zh-TW: 指揮多個背景代理人處理複雜任務時，追蹤進度與分流目錄變得更加井井有條。⟦如同專案總監巡視工地的中央調度台，不僅能依據施工狀態分類篩選待辦工單，還能為特定小組直接開啟獨立的隔離施工艙，且這種分流作業規範現在一開工就全面啟用。⟧在代理人控制中心裡，你可以依照任務狀態快速篩選待辦清單，並直接針對特定任務建立專屬的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工作階段。同時，工作樹支援在本次更新中改為預設開啟，讓你在開發多條分支時無須額外設定即可直接享受獨立目錄的隔離優勢。
body.en: Tracking progress and compartmentalizing directories becomes far more organized when directing multiple background agents on complex tasks. ⟦A project director inspecting a site from a central dispatch console can filter pending work orders by construction status and spin up dedicated, isolated work bays for specific crews, with this compartmentalized workflow now active right from the start.⟧ In the agent command center, you can quickly filter tasks by status and create dedicated worktree sessions for specific assignments. Meanwhile, worktree support is enabled by default in this update, letting you enjoy the isolation benefits of independent directories across multiple branches without extra configuration.

items.original: Filter tasks by status and create worktree sessions from the agent command center; worktree support is now enabled by default. (#46839, #45276, #44870)

title.zh-TW: 終端機推出六款新主題配色，支援即時渲染 Mermaid 圖表與數學公式
title.en: Terminal introduces six new themes, supporting direct rendering of Mermaid diagrams and math equations

body.zh-TW: 看膩了預設的黑底白字，或是讀到複雜的流程邏輯只能盯著純文字自行腦補？⟦好似替客廳換上多種風格的新壁紙與沙發套，而且電視牆還能直接播放流程圖與清楚排版的數學公式看板，不必再把草稿紙翻得眼花撩亂。⟧這次更新為終端機加入了六款全新主題配色，讓你能自由客製化視覺介面。更棒的是，當 AI 在回覆中給出受支援的 Mermaid 圖表或數學展示公式時，終端機現在能直接在回答中將它們視覺化呈現出來，省去將圖表程式碼複製到外部編輯器才能預覽的麻煩。
body.en: Tired of the default black-and-white terminal or struggling to visualize complex process logic from plain text? ⟦Imagine refitting a living room with new wallpapers and sofa covers while the media wall renders flowcharts and neatly formatted math equations directly on screen, sparing you from flipping through messy scratch paper.⟧ This update adds six brand-new color themes to the terminal, allowing you to freely customize your visual interface. Even better, when AI provides supported Mermaid diagrams or display equations in its responses, the terminal can now render them visually right in the output, eliminating the hassle of copying diagram code into external editors just to preview it.

items.original: Customize the terminal with six new themes and view supported Mermaid diagrams and display equations directly in responses. (#46504, #46054, #45612)

title.zh-TW: 支援 /daemon 指令更新背景伺服器，或用 --no-daemon 完全繞過
title.en: Support /daemon command to update background server or bypass it completely with --no-daemon

body.zh-TW: 想升級在本機默默運作的背景服務，或是想單次乾淨啟動而不依賴常駐程序？⟦正如給社區中央供水泵補上獨立升級開關，管理員隨時能下令進行設備更新，住戶若想測試自備水塔也能直接切換獨立閥門、完全不經過中央管線。⟧你現在可以在 Codex 裡輸入 `/daemon`，直接更新本機的守護行程（daemon，在背景持續運作的常駐服務程式）。如果這次不想經過背景伺服器，只要在啟動命令列加上 `--no-daemon` 旗標，就會直接繞過它。
body.en: Need to upgrade a background service running quietly on your local machine, or prefer a clean one-off launch without relying on a resident process? ⟦Just as a community water pump receives a dedicated upgrade switch so managers can trigger equipment updates at any time, residents can also turn an independent valve to test their own water tank without routing through central pipes.⟧ You can now use `/daemon` inside Codex to update the local daemon. If you would rather not go through the background server this time, add the `--no-daemon` flag when launching and it is bypassed.

items.original: Update the local background server through `/daemon`, or bypass it with `--no-daemon`. (#45854, #46088)

title.zh-TW: 對話中斷或編輯提示詞時，完整保留已生成的答案、計畫與設定
title.en: Preserve streamed answers, plans, and settings when conversations are interrupted or prompts are edited

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 規劃冗長步驟卻不幸碰上網路瞬斷、手動中斷，或是想回頭修改剛才的提問時，先前的心血不再瞬間歸零。⟦猶如繪畫師在長卷上作畫，即便畫到一半顏料用盡或臨時被電話打斷，已經勾勒好的底稿與著色計畫依然會穩穩留在畫布上；重新拿起畫筆時能立即接續先前的畫法模式，即使擦改前幾筆線條也不會弄丟整幅畫的圖層標籤與筆刷設定。⟧系統現在會在回合失敗、遭使用者中斷或接收到子代理完成事件時，妥善保留已經串流產生的回覆內容與執行計畫。當你重新續接工作階段時，先前開啟的 Plan 模式會自動精準還原；而在編輯更早之前的提示詞時，對話串的身分識別與自訂設定也能完整延續。
body.en: When you ask AI to plan complex multi-step tasks and run into network dropouts, manual interruptions, or simply want to edit a previous prompt, your earlier progress is no longer lost. ⟦When an artist paints on a long scroll, the sketched drafts and coloring plans remain firmly on canvas even if the paint runs out or a phone call interrupts mid-stroke; picking up the brush immediately restores the previous painting mode, and erasing earlier strokes never loses the layer tags or brush settings.⟧ The system now preserves streamed responses and execution plans when turns fail, are interrupted by the user, or receive subagent completion events. When you resume a session, previously activated Plan mode is restored accurately, and editing earlier prompts preserves thread identity and custom settings.

items.original:
Preserve streamed answers and plans when turns fail, are interrupted, or receive subagent completion events. (#45549, #46867)
Restore Plan mode when resuming sessions and preserve thread identity and settings when editing earlier prompts. (#45519, #45845)

title.zh-TW: 修復 tmux 與 SSH 剪貼簿轉發，貼上文字時保留 Tab 縮排
title.en: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH, preserving Tab indentation on pasted text

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線或終端機分頁軟體工作時，複製貼上程式碼最怕遇到剪貼簿失效或縮排格式被壓扁。⟦跟在辦公室使用跨樓層文件輸送管一樣，遠端傳送的文件能精準送達收件匣，而且就算遇到老舊傳送機把整疊報表拆成單頁逐張送出，系統依然會依照原本的格線與分欄標記工整排好，絕不讓表格欄位錯位。⟧這次更新修正了在 tmux 與 SSH 工作階段中剪貼簿無法正確轉發的問題。同時，當某些終端機將貼上的大段文字拆成個別按鍵訊號逐一送出時，Codex 現在也能完整保留原始的 Tab 縮排格式，不再將排版打亂成純文字。
body.en: When working over remote connections or terminal multiplexers, copying and pasting code often risks broken clipboards or flattened indentations. ⟦Operating like a multi-floor document pneumatic tube system in an office, remotely dispatched files arrive accurately in the inbox, and even if an aging feeder sends a report sheet by sheet, the system arranges them neatly along original gridlines and column markers without misaligned columns.⟧ This update fixes clipboard forwarding failures in tmux and SSH sessions. Additionally, when certain terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes, Codex now preserves the original Tab indentation format rather than scrambling it into plain unformatted text.

items.original: Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH sessions and preserve tab indentation when terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes. (#45457, #45454)

title.zh-TW: 支援透過系統代理伺服器復原登入，修復 MCP 憑證 503 重新整理
title.en: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials on 503 errors

body.zh-TW: 公司網路規定所有連線都得先繞經代理時，Codex 的登入以前容易卡在半路。⟦彷彿外賓進園區規定要走公司的接待櫃台，以前走這條路常被擋在門外，現在能照常換證進門；遇到換證窗口回「忙線中」時，櫃台也會主動幫你重換一張有效的通行證，不再讓你在門口枯等。⟧Codex 現在能透過系統代理伺服器順利復原登入工作階段，確保特殊網路架構下的認證暢通。此外，當外部伺服器的 OAuth 身分探索回傳 503 服務暫時無法使用錯誤時，系統會自動重新整理 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的授權憑證，提升外部工具連線的穩定度。
body.en: On corporate networks that route every connection through a proxy, Codex sign-in used to get stuck halfway. ⟦Picture a visitor who has to enter a campus through the company reception desk: that route used to leave them stuck outside, and now it gets them in; when the badge office answers "line busy", the desk now fetches a fresh pass instead of leaving them waiting at the door.⟧ Codex can now recover login sessions smoothly through system proxies, so sign-in works on networks that route traffic through a proxy. Furthermore, when OAuth identity discovery returns a 503 Service Unavailable error from an external server, the system automatically refreshes MCP (Model Context Protocol) authorization credentials, improving connection stability for external tools.

items.original: Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials when OAuth discovery returns a 503 error. (#46562, #44636)

title.zh-TW: 修補沙盒隔離漏洞，防堵連線穿透、特權通訊端與檔案寫入
title.en: Patch sandbox isolation gaps to block inbound connections, privileged sockets, and file writes

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 在受限環境中測試未知腳本時，環境隔離的防護邊界現在更加固若金湯。⟦類似給金庫隔離艙加裝多重防護閥，既封鎖了外部未經許可的傳入管線，又切斷了內部程式暗中調用高特權通訊通道的可能，並嚴格鎖死唯讀公文櫃的鎖扣、防止任何人偷偷提筆篡改。⟧這次更新修補了沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護環境）的數項隔離漏洞：堵住了涉及 Windows 傳入連線的漏洞、阻斷了 Linux 與 macOS 上存取特權通訊端的管道，並徹底禁止透過 macOS 唯讀檔案控制代碼進行寫入操作。
body.en: When having AI test unknown scripts in restricted environments, the protective perimeter of environmental isolation is now significantly tighter. ⟦Installing multiple protective valves on a vault isolation chamber blocks unauthorized inbound pipelines, cuts off covert attempts by internal programs to access privileged communication channels, and firmly locks read-only document cabinets to prevent illicit alterations.⟧ This update patches several isolation gaps in the sandbox: it closes a gap involving inbound connections on Windows, shuts down avenues for accessing privileged sockets on Linux and macOS, and strictly prohibits write operations through read-only macOS file handles.

items.original: Close sandbox isolation gaps involving inbound Windows connections, privileged Linux/macOS sockets, and writes through read-only macOS file handles. (#44639, #45984, #46500)

title.zh-TW: 淘汰舊版個性設定，釐清代理規則萬用字元並升級 TLS 套件
title.en: Retire legacy personality settings, clarify proxy wildcard rules, and upgrade TLS dependencies

body.zh-TW: 這批更新收攏了幾項設定規則、網路比對與底層套件的規格細節。官方明確釐清先前已標記為棄用的 `friendly` 與 `pragmatic` 個性設定，現在已不再對 AI 的回覆語氣風格產生任何影響。在網路代理的允許與拒絕比對規則中，規則說明補上了問號 `?` 代表匹配單一字元的定義，方便你寫出更精確的代理規則。同時，系統打包的 TLS 安全傳輸相依套件也完成升級，包含為 Linux musl 建置版本納入了 OpenSSL 3.6.4。以前如果對代理規則語法不確定或受限於舊版通訊套件，現在規則寫得清楚，打包的套件也更新到新版。
body.en: This batch of updates consolidates specification details across configuration rules, network matching, and underlying packages. The release explicitly clarifies that the previously deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer have any effect on AI response style. In network proxy allow and deny matching rules, the documentation now explains that the question mark `?` matches a single character, helping you write more precise proxy rules. Meanwhile, bundled TLS security dependencies have been upgraded, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. If you were previously uncertain about proxy rule syntax or constrained by older communication packages, the rules are now spelled out and the bundled secure-connection libraries are up to date.

items.original:
Clarify that deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer select response styles. (#45809)
Explain how `?` matches a single character in network proxy allow and deny patterns. (#46027)
Update bundled TLS dependencies, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. (#45149, #45489)

title.zh-TW: 開啟本機 TUI 畫面時預設關閉推理摘要
title.en: Local TUI sessions now disable reasoning summaries by default

body.zh-TW: 接的模型供應商不支援推理摘要，送出對話就被拒絕？你在終端機開啟本機 TUI（在終端機操作的文字互動介面）工作階段時，現在預設不會主動開啟推理摘要。預設關掉之後，這類供應商就能正常連線。⟦寄包裹時預設只填標準運送單，不再自動夾帶特殊電子格式，以前不支援該格式的代收店家會直接拒收包裹，現在所有站所都能正常收件；要是你特別設定要附，才會一併送出。⟧如果你先前已經在設定檔中指定過推理摘要選項，原本的設定依然會保留並繼續生效。
body.en: Requests rejected because your model provider does not support reasoning summaries? When you start a local TUI (text user interface) session in your terminal, reasoning summaries are now turned off by default. Leaving them off by default lets those providers connect normally. ⟦Think of sending a parcel with a standard shipping form instead of automatically attaching a specialized electronic slip: older partner shops that did not support the format used to reject packages on the spot, but now every station accepts deliveries normally unless you explicitly choose to include the extra slip.⟧ If you already configured explicit reasoning summary options in your settings, your preferences remain saved and will continue to work.

items.original: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 模型推理解析度支援分級，旗標與選單皆可自訂力度
title.en: Tiered Reasoning Effort Support for Models, Configurable via Flag and Menu

body.zh-TW: 當你需要模型處理繁複的架構設計或快速回覆簡短提問時，能自由調配思考深度就顯得格外實用。Antigravity 改進了不同模型對推理解析度（reasoning effort，模型產生答案前的思考運算深度）的支援，讓支援不同思考力度的模型能更精準切換層級。現在只要在啟動指令加上 `--effort` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/effort` 與 `/model`，就能從視覺化量表直接挑選適合的強度。⟦就像騎變速自行車依路況切換檔位，遇到陡峭山路時切換到高檔全力衝刺，平坦直路則換上輕檔快速巡航。⟧ 遇到棘手的重構難題時拉高力度，寫簡短測試或整理資料時調低檔位，思考資源運用更靈活。
body.en: When you need a model to tackle complex architectural designs or quickly answer brief questions, the freedom to adjust thinking depth is especially useful. Antigravity improves support for reasoning effort across different models, allowing models with varying reasoning capabilities to switch levels more precisely. You can now select the right intensity directly from a visual gauge by adding the `--effort` flag to startup commands or running `/effort` and `/model` during a session. ⟦Like shifting gears on a bicycle to match the terrain, a rider shifts into a higher gear for full power on steep climbs and cruises in a lighter gear on flat roads.⟧ Dial up the effort for tricky refactoring tasks and lower it for short tests or data organization, making your thinking resources far more flexible.

items.original: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: 需要設定參數的手動外掛改為預設停用
title.en: Manually Added Plugins That Need Configuration Now Start Disabled

body.zh-TW: 平時若是習慣直接把擴充套件檔案複製到設定資料夾，要注意這些外掛的啟用方式變了。以前直接放進 `~/.gemini/config/plugins` 目錄的外掛，只要內含需要設定參數的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，往往一放進去就嘗試運作；現在它們預設會先保持停用，直到你主動啟用為止。這樣的行為已與透過 `/plugin` 指令安裝的外掛完全一致。⟦如同收到需要裝上電池才能運轉的新家電，出廠時預設切在斷電安全檔，一定要先裝妥配件並手動按下開關才會啟動。⟧
body.en: If you usually copy plugin files directly into the configuration folder, note that these plugins now start up differently. Previously, plugins placed directly in the `~/.gemini/config/plugins` directory would attempt to run immediately if they contained MCP servers requiring configuration parameters; now, they remain disabled by default until you explicitly enable them. This behavior now fully matches plugins installed via the `/plugin` command. ⟦Picture receiving a new household appliance that requires batteries: it arrives safely switched off by default, starting up only after you install the accessories and manually turn on the power switch.⟧

items.original: Changed plugins placed directly in `~/.gemini/config/plugins` so that a plugin whose MCP server needs configuration variables now starts disabled until you enable it, matching plugins installed through `/plugin`.

title.zh-TW: WezTerm 與 VS Code 終端機不再破圖，圖表改以純文字備援顯示
title.en: No More Garbled Graphics in WezTerm and VS Code, Falling Back to Plain Text Diagrams

body.zh-TW: 在 WezTerm 或 VS Code 內建終端機裡查看架構圖或數學公式時，畫面上不再出現一連串令人摸不著頭緒的亂碼方塊。過去輸出 Mermaid 流程圖或 LaTeX 公式時，終端機被誤判為支援 Kitty 繪圖通訊協定，導致畫面印出整排破圖字元；現在已取消這項假設，改以清晰的 ASCII 純文字備援格式顯示，確保圖表與排版內容都能一目了然。
body.en: When viewing architecture diagrams or mathematical formulas inside WezTerm or the VS Code integrated terminal, you will no longer see confusing rows of corrupted placeholder characters. Previously, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts or LaTeX formulas, these terminals were incorrectly assumed to support the Kitty graphics protocol, causing rows of broken characters to print on screen. Antigravity has removed this assumption and now displays them in a clear ASCII fallback format, ensuring that both diagrams and formatted content remain readable at a glance.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX rendering as rows of garbled placeholder characters in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal; these terminals are no longer assumed to support Kitty graphics and now show the ASCII fallback

title.zh-TW: 關閉選取即複製後，成品檢視器釋放滑鼠控制並恢復快速鍵
title.en: Artifact Viewer Releases Mouse Capture When Copy on Select Is Disabled, Restoring Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定中關閉選取自動複製功能時，瀏覽產出的檔案內容不再被強制攔截游標動作。過去在 `/config` 裡將 `Copy on Select` 關閉後，成品檢視器依然會捕捉滑鼠事件，使得終端機原生的選取與複製快速鍵無法使用；現在檢視器已不再佔用滑鼠，終端機本身的複製操作能正常運作，按下 `Ctrl+C` 也會如期執行中斷或退出。
body.en: When you disable automatic copy on selection in settings, browsing generated file contents will no longer hijack your cursor actions. Previously, after turning off `Copy on Select` in `/config`, the artifact viewer continued to capture mouse events, preventing the terminal's native selection and copy shortcuts from working. The viewer now releases the mouse so your terminal's built-in copy operations function normally, and pressing `Ctrl+C` properly interrupts or exits as expected.

items.original: Fixed copying text from the artifact viewer when `Copy on Select` is turned off in `/config`: the viewer no longer captures the mouse, so your terminal's own selection and copy shortcut work, and `Ctrl+C` goes back to interrupting or exiting

title.zh-TW: 專案自訂代理支援修復，桌面端與無頭模式皆能正常選用
title.en: Project Custom Agents Fixed Across Desktop App and Headless Runs

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案目錄下配置專屬的輔助角色時，各個執行環境現在都能順利讀取到這些客製化設定。以前放在 `.agents/agents/` 目錄下的專案自訂代理，容易在桌面應用程式建立的工作區、已信任的工作區、使用 `--agent` 參數、以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式），以及 `/agents` 面板中找不到或無法選取；現在這些辨識問題均已修好，無論在哪種模式下都能直接指派自訂代理。
body.en: When configuring dedicated assistant roles in your project directory, every execution environment can now smoothly load these custom settings. Previously, project custom agents located in `.agents/agents/` were frequently missing or unselectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in trusted workspaces, when specifying `--agent`, in headless `-p` or `--prompt` runs without a terminal window, and within the `/agents` panel. These discovery issues have all been resolved, allowing you to assign custom agents directly in any mode.

items.original: Fixed project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found or selectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in already-trusted workspaces, under execution with --agent, in headless (-p / --prompt) runs, and in the /agents panel.

title.zh-TW: /config 新增中等詳細程度，摘要工具呼叫並保留指令回覆
title.en: /config Adds Medium Verbosity to Summarize Tool Calls While Keeping Commands and Responses Visible

body.zh-TW: 當你交辦複雜任務給助理時，既不想被整頁的工具呼叫與思考細節洗版，又希望能看清執行了哪些指令與最終產出。在 `/config` 設定選單中，現在新增了介於 high 與 low 之間的 medium 詳細程度（Verbosity，控制終端機輸出多寡的設定）選項。切換到這個模式後，助理會把一連串相關的工具呼叫與思考過程，整合成像是 `Explored N files` 這樣的簡短摘要。所有實際跑過的指令與產生的文字回覆，依然會完整顯示在畫面上。Verbosity 設定本身以及底下的每個選項，現在都附上了說明文字，清楚標示各選項會顯示與隱藏哪些內容。⟦好比閱讀晨會的重點簡報，後台密集的資料調度被濃縮成一行要點，關鍵結論與交辦指令依然完整呈現。⟧
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to an agent, you might want to avoid being flooded with pages of tool calls and thought details while still clearly tracking executed commands and final responses. The `/config` settings menu now introduces a `medium` verbosity option between `high` and `low`. In this mode, the agent groups a series of related tool calls and thought processes into concise summaries like `Explored N files`. All executed commands and resulting text responses remain fully visible on the screen. The Verbosity setting and each individual option beneath it now include descriptive text clearly outlining what is shown or hidden. ⟦Picture reading a morning briefing: intensive background data operations are condensed into a single takeaway, while key conclusions and assigned instructions remain fully visible.⟧

items.original: Added `medium` verbosity mode to `/config`, between `high` and `low`, which groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries (such as `Explored N files`) while keeping commands and responses visible; the Verbosity setting and each option now describe what they show

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器圖表渲染加速，多工器環境自動切換文字圖表
title.en: Artifact Viewer Accelerates Diagram Rendering and Falls Back to Text Diagrams in Multiplexers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡開啟圖表或數學公式時，畫面載入與按鍵操作現在更俐落。在支援 Kitty 圖片協定的終端機中，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在背景預先渲染產物，打開瞬間就能看見 Mermaid 圖表與 LaTeX 算式。圖片改以較小尺寸一次上傳，使用 `Ctrl+=` 與 `Ctrl+-` 縮放不再閃爍。檢視器頁尾將置頂與置底提示整併為 `g/G top/bottom`，`m` 鍵會清楚標示切換模式（包含 diagram、LaTeX、ASCII 或 raw），並修復箭頭符號過早折行的問題。在 `tmux` 或 GNU `screen` 內若圖片無法傳入，系統會自動備援降級為 ASCII 純文字圖表避免留白，有設定穿透者仍可用 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制開啟圖片模式。
body.en: Viewing diagrams or math formulas in the terminal is now smoother across loading and key interactions. On terminals supporting the Kitty graphics protocol, the artifact viewer pre-renders artifacts in the background so Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX formulas appear instantly upon opening. Images are uploaded once at a smaller size, eliminating flickering when zooming with `Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`. The viewer footer combines the separate top and bottom hints into `g/G top/bottom`, labels the `m` key with the active switch target (including diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixes hints containing arrow symbols wrapping too early. Inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` where images cannot reach the terminal, the system automatically falls back to ASCII text diagrams to prevent blank gaps, while setups with passthrough can still force image mode using `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`.

items.original:
Improved Mermaid diagram and LaTeX rendering in the artifact viewer on Kitty-compatible terminals: artifacts are pre-rendered in the background so diagrams appear as soon as the viewer opens, images are uploaded once at a smaller size, and zooming with `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` no longer flickers between the old and new sizes
Improved the artifact viewer footer by combining the separate top and bottom hints into one `g/G top/bottom` entry, labeling `m` with the view it switches to (diagram, LaTeX, ASCII, or raw), and fixing hints that contain arrow symbols wrapping onto a new line too early
Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX leaving a blank gap inside `tmux` or GNU `screen` when the outer terminal supports Kitty graphics; the CLI now falls back to ASCII diagrams unless images actually reach the terminal, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode for setups with image passthrough configured

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒降低繞過頻率，失敗步驟標記與 Esc 鍵行為修整
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Reduces Bypass Requests with Refined Failed Step Labels and Esc Key Handling

body.zh-TW: 讓助理在終端機裡自動執行各項指令時，安全防護與按鍵操作現在更符合直覺。終端機沙盒（sandbox，在隔離環境中執行指令以確保安全的機制）現在經過改善，助理要求跳出沙盒確認的頻率明顯降低。助理現在清楚知道沙盒內的指令可以直接讀寫自己的 artifact 與 scratch 資料夾，而且就算前面某個指令曾需要跳出沙盒，接下來的指令依然會優先在沙盒內嘗試。執行結束且回傳非零退出碼的指令，其步驟標題已從原先的 `Errored` 正式改為 `Failed`。當終端機跳出建議下拉選單時，按下 `Esc` 鍵現在會先關閉選單，按第二下 `Esc` 才會中斷助理執行，避免選字時不小心誤按中斷。
body.en: Running commands automatically with an agent in the terminal is now safer and more intuitive. With improvements to the terminal sandbox, the agent requests to bypass the sandbox significantly less often. The agent now recognizes that sandboxed commands can directly read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it continues to prioritize the sandbox for subsequent commands even after an earlier command required a bypass. For commands that finish execution with a non-zero exit code, the step title is formally updated from `Errored` to `Failed`. When the suggestions dropdown is open in the terminal, pressing `Esc` now closes the dropdown first, requiring a second `Esc` press to interrupt the agent and preventing accidental cancellation during autocomplete.

items.original:
Improved terminal sandbox behavior so the agent asks to bypass the sandbox less often: it now knows sandboxed commands can read and write its own artifact and scratch directories, and it tries the sandbox first even after an earlier command needed a bypass
Changed the step title of commands that exit with a non-zero code from `Errored` to `Failed`
Fixed pressing `Esc` while the suggestions dropdown is open interrupting the agent's turn; it now closes the dropdown, and a second `Esc` interrupts

title.zh-TW: 自訂設定檔改為僅掃描當前目錄，巢狀項目需透過 include_only 指定
title.en: Customization Configs Now Scan Top-Level Directories Only, Requiring Nested Items via include_only

body.zh-TW:
當你在專案中自訂技能、規則或外掛目錄時，現在設定檔的載入行為變得更精確可預測。在 `skills.json`、`rules.json`、`agents.json` 與 `plugins.json` 這類自訂設定檔（customization，用於擴充助理能力與行為的設定）中，填入目錄路徑時現在只會載入直接位於該目錄下的第一層項目，行為與預設的 `.agents/skills/` 資料夾一致，不再自動遞迴載入所有子目錄中的內容。如果你想要引入深層子目錄裡的特定巢狀項目，必須在設定項目中透過 `include_only` 明確列出路徑，例如：

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦就像打開收納盒只拿取最上層的物件，若要翻出深層隔袋裡的工具，就得在領取清單上明確標出該項目的名稱。⟧
body.en:
Loading behavior for customization files is now more precise and predictable when defining skills, rules, or plugins directories in a project. In customization files such as `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json`, directory entries now load only first-level items located directly inside that directory—matching the behavior of the default `.agents/skills/` directory—rather than recursively scanning every subdirectory. To include a specific nested item within a deeper subdirectory, you must explicitly specify its path via `include_only`, for example:

```
{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}
```

⟦Think of opening a storage box and picking only top-level items: retrieving a tool tucked away in a deep inner pouch requires explicitly naming it on the retrieval list.⟧

items.original: Changed how directory entries in `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, and `plugins.json` are scanned: an entry now loads only the items directly inside the directory, the same as a `.agents/skills/` folder, instead of recursively loading everything beneath it; to load a nested item, name it in `include_only`, for example `{"path": "shared_skills", "include_only": ["category/my-skill"]}`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式串流中斷回傳錯誤退出碼，JSON 輸出保留部分回覆
title.en: Headless Mode Streaming Errors Now Return Exit Code 3 While JSON Output Retains Partial Responses

body.zh-TW: 把命令列工具放進自動化腳本跑任務時，最怕遇到程式半途出錯卻假裝成功。在以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前若串流輸出中途因模型或助理出錯中斷，程式仍會帶著代表成功的代碼 0 結束。現在這類異常會正確改以退出碼 `3` 結束並印出 `AGY_ERROR` 錯誤行，JSON 錯誤輸出中也會保留出錯前已生成的局部內容，多輪 `stream-json` 工作階段則維持發出警告並繼續執行。
body.en: When running the CLI in automation scripts, silent failures that masquerade as success are a major pitfall. In headless mode executed with `-p` or `--prompt`, streaming outputs interrupted by model or agent errors previously exited with code 0 indicating success. Such failures now properly exit with code `3` and print an `AGY_ERROR` line, while JSON error output preserves the partial response generated prior to the failure, and multi-turn `stream-json` sessions continue to warn and proceed.

items.original: Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs that streamed part of a response and then ended on a model or agent error exiting with code 0; they now exit with code `3` and print the `AGY_ERROR` line, and JSON error output includes the partial response, while multi-turn `stream-json` sessions still warn and continue

title.zh-TW: 舊版遠端控制升級後不再重複當機，自動取消廢棄服務
title.en: Upgraded Legacy Remote Control Installations No Longer Crash Loop and Unregister Deprecated Services

body.zh-TW: 以前使用舊版 Remote Control 安裝腳本設定的機器，在升級版本後常會陷入不斷崩潰重啟的無窮迴圈。現在當命令列工具被該已廢棄的舊版背景服務啟動時，會自動取消註冊該背景服務，並提示改用 `remote-control start` 指令啟動，徹底解決升級後反覆當機重開的問題。
body.en: Machines configured with legacy Remote Control installer scripts previously fell into infinite crash loops after upgrading. When the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service, it now automatically unregisters the background service and prompts switching to the `remote-control start` command, completely resolving crash loops after upgrades.

items.original: Fixed machines set up with the old Remote Control installer script crash-looping after an upgrade; when the CLI is launched by that deprecated background service it now unregisters the service and points to `remote-control start` instead of restarting repeatedly

title.zh-TW: 子代理工作樹檔案不再誤當成品，隔離存放避免殘留元資料
title.en: Subagent Worktree Files Are No Longer Mistaken for Artifacts to Prevent Metadata Residue

body.zh-TW: 呼叫背景助手平行處理程式碼時，專案目錄不再被莫名其妙的說明檔弄亂。以前在 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）中寫入一般檔案時，系統會誤以為那是產物，強制要求附帶描述並留下 `.metadata.json` 檔案。現在子代理的工作樹統一移至資料目錄下的 `worktrees/` 資料夾，這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When invoking background agents to work on code in parallel, project directories will no longer be cluttered with unexpected metadata files. Previously, writing standard files inside a Git worktree caused the system to mistake them for artifacts, demanding descriptions and leaving `.metadata.json` files behind. Subagent worktrees now reside under a unified `worktrees/` folder in the app data directory, resolving this issue.

items.original: Fixed files that subagents write inside their own Git worktree being treated as artifacts, which demanded artifact metadata and left `.metadata.json` files in the worktree; subagent worktrees now live under a `worktrees/` directory in the app data directory

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示詞可用 @ 指名子代理，自動補齊快速對話
title.en: Mention Subagents with @ in Prompts for Fast Messaging with Autocomplete

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開了好幾個背景工作幫手，想要單獨插話交辦新任務，現在只要在輸入框打個 @ 符號就能辦到。現在新增了 `@<subagent> <message>` 提示詞語法，能直接把訊息發給指定的子代理（subagent，在背景獨立處理特定任務的助理）。打字時只要輸入 @ 就會跳出自動補齊選單，清單會列出目前正在執行以及已經完成的子代理名稱。例如研究助理剛查完資料，你直接打 `@research 幫我整理成三點結論` 就能繼續追問，不必手動切換對話。⟦彷彿在專案群組裡打出標註符號，選單立刻列出在線與已完工的全部同事，點名就能直接交代待辦事項。⟧
body.en: When running multiple background helpers and wanting to chime in with a new task, you can now do so simply by typing an @ symbol in the input box. The newly added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax lets you send messages directly to a specific subagent (an assistant handling dedicated tasks in the background). Typing @ brings up an autocomplete menu listing the names of both running and completed subagents. For example, right after a research assistant finishes gathering info, you can type `@research summarize this into three key takeaways` to follow up without manually switching conversations. ⟦Think of tagging someone in a project group chat, where a popup menu lists all active and finished colleagues so you can assign action items right away.⟧

items.original: Added `@<subagent> <message>` prompt syntax to send a message directly to a subagent conversation, with autocomplete listing running and completed subagents

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式支援數字倍數前綴，多行與區塊操作一氣呵成
title.en: Vim Mode Adds Numeric Count Multipliers for Multi-Line and Block Operations in One Go

body.zh-TW:
習慣在終端機裡用 Vim 快速修整文字的讀者，現在不用再狂按同一組快捷鍵了。編輯器現在支援數字倍數乘數，在一般模式（Normal mode，游標移動與執行指令的狀態）以及選取模式中，你可以在動作、移動與運算子前面加上次數。常用的整行刪除、貼上、復原、游標跳轉到指定行或選取多層括號區塊，都能直接加倍執行：

```
3dw    # 刪除接下來的 3 個單字
2d3w   # 執行 2 次刪除 3 個單字
3dd    # 刪除 3 行
3x     # 刪除 3 個字元
3rX    # 將接下來 3 個字元替換為 X
3p     # 連續貼上 3 次
3u     # 連續復原 3 次動作
5G     # 移動至第 5 行（支援 [count]G、gg 與 $）
2di(   # 刪除外層第 2 層括號內的文字物件
```

⟦如同給常用指令蓋上倍數印章，以前得連按好幾次按鍵的操作，現在敲個數字加指令就能一口氣整批執行完畢。⟧
body.en:
If you are used to editing text quickly with Vim in the terminal, you no longer have to mash the same shortcuts repeatedly. The editor now supports numeric count multipliers. In Normal mode (the state for moving the cursor and running commands) and Visual mode, you can prefix actions, motions, and operators with a count. Common operations like deleting whole lines, pasting, undoing, jumping to a specific line, or selecting nested bracket blocks can now run in multiples:

```
3dw    # Delete the next 3 words
2d3w   # Run delete 3 words 2 times
3dd    # Delete 3 lines
3x     # Delete 3 characters
3rX    # Replace the next 3 characters with X
3p     # Paste 3 times consecutively
3u     # Undo 3 actions consecutively
5G     # Jump to line 5 (supports [count]G, gg, and $)
2di(   # Delete the inner text object inside the 2nd outer bracket level
```

⟦Picture stamping your frequent commands with a multiplier mark, turning repeated keystrokes into a single batch execution with just a number and a key.⟧

items.original: Added Vim numeric count multipliers so counts apply to operators, motions, and actions in Normal and Visual modes, including `3dw`, `2d3w`, `3dd`, `3x`, `3rX`, `3p`, `3u`, `[count]G`/`gg`/`$`, and counted text objects such as `2di(`

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式守護程序正常退場，背景耗時任務不再被提早中斷
title.en: Headless Daemons Exit Cleanly and Long Background Tasks Run to Completion

body.zh-TW: 用腳本串接命令列工具來自動跑任務時，最怕背景工作沒跑完就被砍掉、或是執行結束後卡住不放。在以 -p 或 --prompt 執行的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的自動執行模式）下，以前程式退出後常殘留背景守護程序。這會導致讀取輸出的外部腳本一直等不到結尾訊號而卡死，現在常駐程序會在執行結束時確實終止。另外，以前助理只要閒置約 5 秒，就會誤把還在跑的背景任務直接取消；現在會持續等待背景任務完成，最長可等到 --print-timeout 指定的期限，上限為 30 分鐘。⟦跟自動化產線收工一樣，系統會等手上最後一件耗時組裝確實完工才打卡，下班時也會把廠房電源全數關閉不留尾巴。⟧
body.en: When scripting command-line tools to automate tasks, you never want background jobs killed prematurely or hanging indefinitely after execution finishes. In headless mode (an automated execution mode without a terminal UI) run with -p or --prompt, background daemon processes previously lingered after exit. This caused external scripts reading CLI output to hang while waiting for an EOF signal, but daemons now terminate cleanly when the run ends. Additionally, when the agent sat idle for about 5 seconds, it previously cancelled still-running background tasks by mistake. Runs now keep waiting for background tasks until the --print-timeout deadline, capped at 30 minutes. ⟦Just like wrapping up an automated assembly line, the system waits for the last time-consuming build to finish before clocking out, completely powering down the workshop without leaving anything behind.⟧

items.original:
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs leaving daemon background processes running after exit, which could hang scripts reading the CLI's output until end-of-file; daemon processes now terminate when the run ends
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs cancelling still-running background tasks about 5 seconds after the agent went idle; runs now wait for background tasks until the `--print-timeout` deadline, up to a 30-minute cap

title.zh-TW: 修復對話歷史資料庫損毀風險，改善上下文壓縮與串流穩定度
title.en: Fix History Database Corruption Risks, Context Compaction, and Streaming Stability

body.zh-TW: 當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗、或是進行超長篇對話時，底層資料庫與連線都不再無預警出錯。以前多個處理程序同時存取同一個對話歷史資料庫時，檢查寫入權限的動作可能會悄悄丟失檔案鎖（file lock，防止多個程式同時寫入同一檔案的鎖定機制），造成資料庫損壞風險。當對話過長觸發上下文壓縮（context compaction，自動濃縮歷史以節省空間的機制）時，部分情境下用於建立檢查點的工具設定曾遭到拒絕而導致壓縮失敗。模型串流回傳資料時，要是封包缺少外層回應信封，先前會觸發後端當機並以連線錯誤終止工作階段。現在這些資料庫鎖定、壓縮檢查點與串流封包解析問題都已修復。
body.en: When opening multiple terminal windows at once or having very long conversations, underlying databases and connections no longer fail unexpectedly. When multiple processes accessed the same conversation history database concurrently, checking write permissions previously risked silently dropping file locks (a locking mechanism preventing multiple programs from writing to the same file at once), creating a database corruption risk. When long chats triggered context compaction (a mechanism that summarizes history to save space), tool configurations used for compaction checkpoints were rejected in certain scenarios, causing compaction to fail. When the model streamed response chunks without an outer response envelope, it previously triggered a backend crash that terminated the session with connection errors. These database locking, compaction checkpoint, and stream packet parsing issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a conversation-history database corruption risk where checking the database file for write access could silently drop file locks held by concurrent CLI processes on the same file
Fixed context compaction failing when the tool configuration used for compaction checkpoints was rejected in certain scenarios
Fixed a backend crash when a streamed model response chunk arrived without its response envelope, which terminated the session with connection errors

title.zh-TW: Markdown 跨行檔案連結不再破版，符號連結正確顯示名稱
title.en: Markdown Multi-Line File Links No Longer Break Alignment, Code Links Show Clean Text

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看模型產出的表格與程式碼清單時，畫面排版現在變得整齊乾淨。以前表格儲存格如果包含換行折疊的檔案連結，整張 Markdown 表格的欄位對齊就會歪掉破版；現在即使連結文字跨行折疊，欄位依然能維持精確對齊。另外，指向函式或類別等程式碼符號的檔案連結，過去常遺失自訂顯示文字，直接把長長一串原始檔案路徑印出來；現在修復後會正常顯示原本的描述文字。⟦就像排版整齊的型錄表格，即使品名附帶超連結且折成兩行，整欄格線依然筆直對齊，按鈕上也好好印著簡潔名稱而非冗長路徑。⟧
body.en: When viewing model-generated tables and code listings in the terminal, the layout is now clean and tidy. Previously, if a table cell contained a file link that wrapped across lines, the column alignment of the entire Markdown table would break. Even when link text wraps across multiple lines, table columns now maintain precise alignment. Additionally, file links pointing to code symbols like functions or classes often dropped their custom display text, rendering a long raw file path instead. This is now fixed so the intended descriptive text displays properly. ⟦A neatly formatted catalog table keeps its grid lines perfectly straight even when product links wrap across two lines, showing clean labels on buttons instead of raw file paths.⟧

items.original:
Fixed markdown table column alignment when a table cell contains file links that wrap across lines
Fixed markdown file links to code symbols dropping their display text and rendering the raw path instead

title.zh-TW: 登入行為一致化，未完成的企業驗證憑證自動清除
title.en: Consistent Sign-In Behavior and Automatic Cleanup for Incomplete Enterprise Credentials

body.zh-TW: 在不同登入方式之間切換、或是驗證中途斷線時，帳號狀態處理現在更順手。使用 GEMINI_API_KEY 環境變數啟動的工作階段，過去與一般登入路徑存在些許行為差異，現在已修復並減少兩者的行為落差。另外在進行企業帳號登入時，若在挑選授權或專案之前就關閉瀏覽器視窗，以前會殘留卡住的局部憑證（credential，記錄登入身分的授權資料）而無法重試。現在會自動清除未完成的殘餘憑證，讓你直接乾淨重試登入。⟦恰似訪客在發卡機前登記，若手續辦到一半中途離開，機器會自動收回未完成的臨時卡，方便下一回重新乾淨取證。⟧
body.en: Handling account states is now smoother when switching between sign-in methods or disconnecting mid-authentication. Sessions started with the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable previously had slight behavior discrepancies compared to the standard sign-in path, which are now resolved. Furthermore, during enterprise account sign-ins, closing the browser window before selecting a license or project previously left behind stuck partial credentials (authorization data recording sign-in identity) that blocked retries. Incomplete leftover credentials are now cleared automatically so you can retry sign-in cleanly. ⟦When a visitor registers at a badge kiosk and walks away halfway through, the machine retrieves the unfinished temporary card so the next attempt can start fresh.⟧

items.original:
Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to reduce behavior discrepancies with the non-API-key sign-in path
Fixed incomplete enterprise sign-ins (for example closing the browser window before finishing license or project selection) leaving behind a stuck partial credential; such credentials are now cleared automatically so sign-in can be retried cleanly

title.zh-TW: 成品檢視器顯示平移提示，回溯面板自動聚焦最新步驟
title.en: Artifact Viewer Shows Pan Hints, Rewind Panel Auto-Focuses Latest Step

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡查看生成產物或回頭翻找對話歷程時，多處介面細節變得更順手。當大型圖表超出視窗寬度時，成品檢視器（artifact viewer，瀏覽產出圖表與文件的介面）會在底部顯示向左或向右平移的提示。開啟 /rewind 回溯面板時，各步驟會標上相對時間，並在面板打開時自動聚焦在最新步驟。在指令授權方面，白名單建議現在能精準辨識 jj config 與 jj op 子指令，方便你直接設定永久允許。瀏覽器隨行頁面的分頁標題也修正為大寫縮寫的 Antigravity CLI。這些介面與指令辨識的修整，讓日常瀏覽圖表與回溯操作更俐落。
body.en: Several UI details are now smoother when reviewing generated artifacts or browsing past conversation history in the terminal. When a wide diagram overflows the window width, the artifact viewer (an interface for browsing generated diagrams and documents) shows a Left/Right pan hint in the footer. Opening the /rewind panel displays relative timestamps for each step and automatically focuses on the most recent step when the panel opens. For command authorization, allow-listing suggestions now accurately recognize jj config and jj op subcommands when offering to always allow a command. The browser companion page title has also been corrected to the capitalized acronym Antigravity CLI. These interface and command recognition refinements make viewing diagrams and rewinding history much crisper.

items.original:
Improved the artifact viewer to show a Left/Right pan hint in the footer when a wide diagram overflows the window
Improved `/rewind` to show a relative timestamp for each step and to focus the most recent step when the panel opens
Improved command allow-listing suggestions to recognize `jj config` and `jj op` subcommands when offering to always allow a command
Fixed the browser companion page title to read `Antigravity CLI` instead of `Antigravity Cli`

title.zh-TW: 選單列記憶體減半且刷新變快，HTML 報表二次載入縮短至 0.1 秒
title.en: Menu bar memory halved and refreshes faster, HTML report second load drops to 0.1 seconds

body.zh-TW: 讓電腦整天掛著 usage 監控用量，現在吃掉的記憶體和 CPU 都少了很多。實測顯示選單列記憶體從 263 MB 降到約 130 MB，每次刷新從 1.2～1.65 秒 CPU 降至 0.16～0.47 秒。Grok 紀錄只在帶花費時才解 JSON（22,491 行裡只有 212 行），無變動時直接沿用。歷史快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）略過來源檔已刪除的項目，並丟掉同一份 Claude 紀錄裡重複的行。這類重複行占快取項目的 57%；另外讓重複模型、專案與工作階段字串共用一份，並只重寫變動分片。今日與昨日合計改用本地日界線比較，升級後首次開啟會重讀紀錄重建快取。產生 HTML 報表時快取上限由 512 提高至 4096，第二次載入從 5.0 秒降至 0.1 秒。⟦會計師整理年度發票時，先把重複的抬頭合用同一個印章，沒變動的帳冊不再整本重抄，結算速度省下一大半時間。⟧
body.en: Leaving usage running all day to monitor consumption now takes far less memory and CPU.
